scene: Before we enter the Collusion, we are now entering the Seine, where Marinette and Adrien arrive at the Liberty on Marinette's mini scooter. Nino is waiting for them. They take off their helmets.
conversation:
Marinette: Everything okay, Nino?
Adrien: We came as soon as we got your message
Marinette: Adrien was giving me my first tamarin lesson- (stutters) I mean, first Mandarin lesson

scene: Liberty. Nino is walking with Marinette and Adrien following.
conversation:
Nino: And it's still there in one form or another
Marinette: That's terrible. (A noise is heard, causing the houseboat to rumble.)
Nino: This morning, the situation suddenly got worse

conversation:
Adrien: I'm sorry, I didn't even know about this
Marinette: (as she holds Adrien's hand) We know it's a 3d avatar of you. It's not your fault, Adrien. (the rumbling gets louder causing everything to shake once more.)
Ivan: The engine won't hold out! There's too much plastic to get rid of!

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. Marinette and her friends are listening to Tom.
conversation:
Tom: (notices the state Mylène is in) Are you kids sure that you don't mind?
Marinete: Of course not. Daughters help parents and friends help friends. So friends help friends help friends parents, right parents-(stammers) I mean friends?
Warehouse Worker: And the 10,000 plastic candy bags for the Dupain-Cheng bakery! It's all here! (Mylène faints again with Ivan catching her.)

scene: Bertrand King's plastic warehouse. A man is carrying a box and stacks it on top of other boxes.
conversation:
Warehouse Worker: And the 10,000 plastic candy bags for the Dupain-Cheng bakery! It's all here! (Mylène faints again with Ivan catching her.)
Marinette: Thank you, sir! (remembers something) Excuse me sir, would it be possible for us to meet your boss? (Both look toward a statue of Bertrand King.)
Warehouse Worker: Mr. Bertrand King? The King of Plastics? (laughs) No, he never comes here. (points upward) Bosses are up there, on top of the social ladder
Marinette: (as she also points upward) And where can we find the top of the social ladder?

scene: Bertrand King's office. Bertrand walks to the table and sits down.
conversation:
Nino: Products such as plastic bags, wrappers
Marinette: and your Morpho fans
Adrien: What we've come to ask you is to help us put an end to plastic pollution

scene: Bertrand King's office. Bertrand walks to the table and sits down.
conversation:
Marinette: The world won't change without us and you, Mr. Plastic (Stutters) Bertrand (Stutters some more) King-I mean, Mr. King of Plastic
Marinette: (as Markov stops projecting) We're done
Bertrand: That was the clearest presentation I've ever been given. And of course you're right, people buy cheap plastic items, (Max and Mylène look at each other and nod) throw them away and buy those same plastic items over and over again

scene: Outside. The group is sitting on the steps feeling down.
conversation:
Max: The King of Plastic has caused our enthusiasm to drop 99.8%. (a Morpho fan is dropped in front of them. Marinette notices)
Marinette: There's no way we're standing by and doing nothing
André: But Parisians love the Morpho fans, my young friend. Removing the vending machines installed by City Hall across Paris
Marinette: Would make it possible to reduce pollution
André: But it would be very damaging to my image. (opens up a fan with his face on it)

scene: City. Adrien is talking to Marinette on video with the others in the background.
conversation:
Adrien: (on phone) My father hasn't listened to me at all
Marinette: Hold on, we might have one more chance
Nadja: I just can't report Bertrand King's practices in my news broadcast
Marinette: (as Manon is drawing beside her) But, why not?
Nadja: Because the King of Plastic is also the king of our TV channel. It's the money from his advertisements that allows us to exist
Marinette: But if you don't talk about it, people will never know why the products he sells cause pollution. Please, Nadja. Do it for Manon! For the world she'll grow up in!
Nadja: If I did, the world she'll grow up in will be a world where her mom no longer had a job. I'm sorry, Marinette

scene: Dupain-Cheng living room. Tom and Sabine are seen watching the broadcast.
conversation:
Marinette: Sorry to interrupt your TV news. I'm Marinette and for the past few days, my friends and I have tried to raise awareness of a serious problem to people who have the power to act
Marinette: But none of them have taken us seriously
Tom and Sabine: Marinette?!

scene: Gabriel's atelier. Gabriel is watching the broadcast.
conversation:
Adrien: (while looking at Marinette, who blushes) It's so beautiful, that you'd want to keep it forever. (Marinette pulls out a bamboo fan of her own. She then raises it in the air.)
Marinette: Let's demand change from the people who have the power to implement environmentally sustainable solutions. (Closes the fan) For the world of tomorrow is built by the choices we all make today
Nadja: This initiative by young people from all around the world, which you discovered as an exclusive live in yesterday's broadcast, has elicited many reactions. (Screen changes to show André being interviewed.)

scene: Marinette's balcony. Marinette is crouching down.
conversation:
Marinette: Monarch is polluting us with yet another one of his supervillains! (lets Tikki out of her purse.)
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (transforms into Ladybug)
Cat Noir: Meow, m'lady!

scene: Interior, the Dupain-Cheng's residence, in Marinette's room. Marinette takes Zoé in her room.
conversation:
Denis Damoclès: Well, perfect, then! We'll meet with you both tonight to find out what you've planned. Surprise us!
Marinette: We're going to make a great team! Wait 'til you hear my ideas— (turns around to look at Zoé, who seems to have stopped moving) You okay, Zoé?
Zoé: (wide-eyed) Your room is... beautiful!!
Marinette: Oh! Silly me. You've never been here before. Let me show you around! (pulls Zoé with her) This is my chaise lounge. I made it myself from salvaged parts. (opens her chest which happens to have tons of photos of Adrien inside and her gifts for his future birthdays) That's my storage chest— IT needs some tidying up. (holds her mannequin) My mannequin for working on my fashion designs, (scurries to her computer table) my desk, where I do my homework... and now, my most important spot: my creative workshop — with my sewing machine, threads, fabrics
Zoé: (takes a look at Marinette's notebook) Woah... that's gorgeous!
Marinette: (chuckles) Thanks! It's just a sketch, of course. That's the dress I'd like to make for the dance. Well, I still have to get all the necessary pieces, but I hope I'll have time and... (accidentally pulls her "Adrien" drop down board) WAH! Oops, sorry! That's kind of dangerous and useless anyhow. I should just get rid of it already. I'm past all those "crazy" plans to try and talk to Adrien anyhow. (retracts her "Adrien" drop down board) Come on! Let's head to the patio!

scene: Interior, the Dupain-Cheng's residence, in Marinette's room. Marinette takes Zoé in her room.
conversation:
Marinette: (chuckles) Thanks! It's just a sketch, of course. That's the dress I'd like to make for the dance. Well, I still have to get all the necessary pieces, but I hope I'll have time and... (accidentally pulls her "Adrien" drop down board) WAH! Oops, sorry! That's kind of dangerous and useless anyhow. I should just get rid of it already. I'm past all those "crazy" plans to try and talk to Adrien anyhow. (retracts her "Adrien" drop down board) Come on! Let's head to the patio!
Marinette: Outdoors at the Trocadero?
Zoé: Under the vault of the Grand Palais?
Marinette: (gasps) The Eiffel Tower! It's the perfect place! (starts sketching on her sketchbook) That's where we should have our first kiss! It has to be exceptional, magical, (miraculous—) (gasps) I know, I need to learn how to say "I love you" first. I'm good at dreaming about it, but when it comes to actually doing something? It's almost impossible. Although... you could help me!
Zoé: Help you with what?
Marinette: I was thinking we could ask your stepfather about using the Eiffel Tower for the dance. But... maybe you don't want to bother him with that
Zoé: No, totally the opposite! Let's go talk to Anaximandre!
Marinette: Um... who?
Zoé: I mean, let's go talk to my stepdad, the Mayor of Paris!
Marinette: I just realized that if your "lovely" half-sister sees us together, she'll make your life a living nightmare!
Zoé: Chloé doesn't have that power anymore!

scene: Exterior, Le Grand Paris. As the girls are about to enter the building, Marinette stops and panics for a moment.
conversation:
Chloé: Don't you dare go ANYWHERE near my room!!
Marinette: Wow...! What happened to the scared Zoe who moved here from New York a few months ago?
Zoé: It's all thanks to you, Marinette. You're the one who helped me change!

scene: Exterior, Le Grand Paris. As the girls are about to enter the building, Marinette stops and panics for a moment.
conversation:
Zoé: Marinette and I have been selected to plan for the end-of-the-year dance at school, and we were wondering if there is any way we can have it on the Eiffel Tower!
Marinette: (holds up her sketch book containing the sketches of her plan) There'll be a concert, then a DJ set, a buffet, and for those who don't like to dance, a trampoline stretched between the four pillars of the tower!
Andre: Interesting! (a montage of Andre as a cinematographer flashes on the background as he gets carried away) We could also film the evening, and the images would be projected in real time on a giant screen. A film within the film about the film of the party, because cinema is life and life is cinema... (montage ends) and if someone needed to proclaim their love for somebody else, this would be the perfect place and time for it... (clears throat) Well, by the power vested in me, the city of Paris authorizes to hold this party on the Eiffel Tower. (gives the sketchbook back to Marinette)
Marinette: (takes her sketchbook from Andre) Thank you, Mr. Mayor!
Andre: And by the way, if Chloé comes asking questions, (whispers) we never had this conversation

scene: Interior, Le Grand Paris, in Zoé's room. Marinette, who comes in with Zoé, enters the room, ecstatic.
conversation:
Lila: (I) have the perfect plan to get rid of her (for good), but it's going to require... you two. (points at Chloé and Sabrina)
Marinette: Wow... we're actually getting the Eiffel Tower!! (squeals) Well, we should probably plan this afternoon, go see Kitty Section and Nino for the music, my parents for the buffet— oh, and we need a florist for the decor. This is going to be the best party ever!
Sabrina: But... I can't do something like that! (gets down on her knees) Chloé, I'd do anything to help you, but this... this goes against everything I stand for! You know my dad is a police officer! I just can't!

scene: At the Eiffel Tower. All the people that Marinette and Zoé have collaborated with are gathered with them at the venue.
conversation:
Marinette: Uh— no! I don't think about him THAT much, you know? He doesn't belong to me. Well, I mean, he kinda does a little, but none of this matters because no one really belongs to anyone! What matters is (leans closer to Zoé) what brings us together and what you and I are supposed to do. You know, organize the school dance?
Marinette: Once all the students are here, Kitty Section will open the evening with a concert. Anyone who doesn't like dancing
Zoé: And who isn't afraid of heights
Marinette: can have fun on a huge trampoline set up between the feet of the Eiffel Tower

scene: At the Eiffel Tower. All the people that Marinette and Zoé have collaborated with are gathered with them at the venue.
conversation:
Marinette: can have fun on a huge trampoline set up between the feet of the Eiffel Tower
Marinette: My parents will have to prepare a buffet with the Dupain-Cheng bakery's most popular specialty
Zoé: We'll also have the chance to enjoy beautiful decorative works by our talented, favorite florist!

scene: At the Eiffel Tower. All the people that Marinette and Zoé have collaborated with are gathered with them at the venue.
conversation:
Chloé: There will be no obstruction to my justice!!
Marinette: (in disbelief) What???
Zoé: Chloé's planned all this!!

scene: Exterior, Le Grand Paris. Marinette's given Zoé a ride back to the hotel on her scooter.
conversation:
Marinette: It was so kind of you, Zoé, but... don't ever sacrifice yourself for me or anyone else. And the same thing goes for your feelings
Marinette: (sighs) I know... you're in love with Adrien. Don't sacrifice your feelings for him because of me. He has the right to hear your declaration
Zoé: Adrien?! But you're the one he loves
Marinette: Even if he loves me, he'd be flattered to know that you love him too. Let him know how you feel about him... (Zoé frowns and looks down.) Zoé, you're an amazing person. One can only feel honored to be loved by you
Zoé: Are you sure?
Marinette: Of course! You can't keep it to yourself!
Zoé: But... Adrien’s not the one I’m in love with
Marinette: Oh? Who is it, then?

scene: Exterior, Le Grand Paris. Marinette's given Zoé a ride back to the hotel on her scooter.
conversation:
Marinette: Oh? Who is it, then?
Marinette: Oh... Oh! Oh. (Zoé keeps her tender, loving smile and gaze at Marinette as the two share an embrace moments after) I am (truly), very honored. I mean it, Zoé
Zoé: Thanks, Marinette. (they let go of their embrace) You're right! It's such a relief to get these things off your chest. You should try it, too!
Marinette: What do you mean?
Zoé: Adrien! What are you waiting for? Go tell him you love him!
Marinette: But— wait what? How is he going to react? And what am I going to say to him?? What if I just do what I always do — mess things up and definitely ruin things between us?!
Zoé: Marinette... I've been wanting to tell you how I feel since the day I met you. But since you're madly in love with Adrien, I thought it would be pointless and ruin things between us. But look, I just told you, and I can see it doesn't change anything
Marinette: Which changes everything for me
Zoé: You were right: telling someone that you love them doesn't ruin anything. It's time you started taking your own advice, too. (Marinette becomes wide-eyed.) What are you waiting for? Go!
Marinette: Adrien!! (runs and pants as she stops in front of him)

scene: Exterior, the Agreste mansion, outside the gate. Adrien is seen walking towards the entrance.
conversation:
Marinette: I— My hair is a mess, I'm not wearing my princess dress, there's no music, no rose petals everywhere, and we're not on the Eiffel Tower. But even though this isn't at all how I'd imagined this magical moment would play out, it feels right
Marinette: Adrien, I love you
Adrien: This couldn't be any more magical, Marinette

conversation:

Alix: My old man gave me this for my birthday. This watch is totally a family heirloom
Marinette: (narrating) And I would've felt the same. That watch looked like there was something special about it
Alix: Ladybug, your gonna need this
Marinette: (narrating) Oh I think I got it

Marinette: (on videocall) Are you sure your dad won't let you come? It's such a bummer
Adrien: (on videocall) You know how overprotective he is. One day he'll realize I'm not a child anymore, but we're not quite there yet. (Marinette chuckles)

Hawk Moth: A big sister with the best of intentions, unappreciated and unwanted — ideal prey for my akumas. (turns a butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize her broken spirit!

Alya: Wow! (looks at Nino, who looks sad, and her facial expression shifts to concerned) What's up?

conversation:

Marinette: (turns around and looks through the window) I don't see anything. Maybe it was a bird
Nino: (still embracing Alya) Dude, please don't tell me we're gonna be stuck up here!

conversation:

Marinette: No!
Chloé: (to Thomas) You! Go fetch me a chocolate macaron, but make sure it's dark chocolate, not milk chocolate. Got that?

conversation:

Marinette: Do you know her?

Marinette: Yeah, later! (looks for Adrien, but she only sees Nino. He smiles nervously while waving and walking towards her. Marinette speaks to Alya) Where's Adrien?

conversation:

Marinette: (confused) Huh?

scene: The Zoo. Marinette turns on a speaker in her left ear.
conversation:
Alya: (reacting, from the earpiece) Of course we do, you dumbo!
Marinette: Of course we do, you dumb—oh I mean, wasn't he supposed to come? Don't you wanna wait for him?
Adrien: (from the earpiece) Tell her you want to be alone with her

scene: Marinette and Nino are sitting at a picnic table waiting for Adrien.
conversation:
Adrien: Hey, what are you doing?
Marinette: You do? Well, I can help you with that
Nino: You could?

scene: Marinette and Nino are sitting at a picnic table waiting for Adrien.
conversation:

conversation:
Tikki: Why didn't you listen to Alya, Marinette?

conversation:
Nino: Do you want one, Marinette?

scene: Marinette's room. Ladybug transforms back into Marinette, exhausted.
conversation:

Marinette;: Adrien was there!

conversation:
Marinette and Adrien: (at the same time with their respective Kwami) Time to transform!
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)

scene: Outside Le Grand Paris. Reporters swarm Ladybug, but her transformation is about to run out.
conversation:
Antibug: I love a good catfight! (Cat Noir and Antibug start fighting)
Marinette: Oh no! I don't have any food for you Tikki!
Tikki: Don't worry Marinette, you'll find something
Marinette: Uh, I'll try. (checks the news on her phone)

scene: Outside Le Grand Paris. Reporters swarm Ladybug, but her transformation is about to run out.
conversation:
Tikki: I'm giving you advice, now take it! Don't make the same mistake twice!
Marinette: Got an idea! (taps something on her phone)
Antibug: Four…!

scene: Outside Le Grand Paris. Reporters swarm Ladybug, but her transformation is about to run out.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Ready for round two? (they start to fight again and they go up to the rooftop)
Marinette: It worked!
Tikki: I'm good to go, Marinette
Marinette: Yes!

scene: Outside Le Grand Paris. Reporters swarm Ladybug, but her transformation is about to run out.
conversation:
Marinette: Yes!
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Ha! (Marinette turns into Ladybug)

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont, Literature classroom. Chloé walks into the classroom.
conversation:
Chloé: Well? What are you doing? Sit down. (Sabrina gasps and sits down happily. Chloé shows a small smile)

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont, Literature classroom. Chloé walks into the classroom.
conversation:
Chloé: Yeah, yeah. You can show me your gratitude later, class is starting. (smiles again)
Marinette: I think they'll always be BFFs. In their own way
Alya: I still prefer our way, though. (they playfully meet knuckles and smile to each other, below them Adrien smiles as well. Fades to the end card of them and pictures of Ladybug to the left, Cat Noir in the center looking at Ladybug, and Antibug to the right)

scene: Flashback near the Eiffel Tower in black-and-white except for red searchlights: comparatively young Wang Fu and young Marianne Lenoir are running away from the Nazis during World War II
conversation:
Marianne: (stops near the Seine and Fu turns around) Wait! We have to fight, Fu! Let's use the Miraculous: I'll take the Ladybug and you take the Black Cat!
Master Fu: But what if we fail? They'll get hold of this box and it will mean the end of the world! Come with me, we'll be safe in England

scene: Flashback near the Eiffel Tower in black-and-white except for red searchlights: comparatively young Wang Fu and young Marianne Lenoir are running away from the Nazis during World War II
conversation:
Master Fu: (as sad background music commences) I'll come back for this... and you
Marianne: (holding Fu's clenched fists) I'll be waiting for you, right here, every day!
Master Fu: Marianne, I've never told you this, but I—
Marianne: (placing her finger on his lips.) Shh. Tell me when you come back!

scene: Meanwhile, at Marinette's room from the present day.
conversation:
Marinette: Couldn't we try Juleka's idea instead?
Marinette: But I just can't do that! (dramatically flops her head down) I can't talk to him without (raises her head making melodramatic hand gestures) stumbling all over my words. I've been trying for months and... (gasps as she sees Wayzz peeking through her bedroom window) And... you're right! (nervously giggles and starts dragging the girls out of her room as they gasp in surprise) It's about time things change. I'll find the courage, somehow. Thanks, girls!
Alya: (turns to face Marinette in surprise) You sure you'll be okay?
Marinette: (nervously scratching the back of her head) Yeah, sure! I'll let you know what happens. (shuts the trapdoor, shooing Alya out) Bye, girls!

scene: Meanwhile, at Marinette's room from the present day.
conversation:
Marinette: (nervously scratching the back of her head) Yeah, sure! I'll let you know what happens. (shuts the trapdoor, shooing Alya out) Bye, girls!
Marinette: Wayzz! (Wayzz phases through the window and Tikki appears) What's going on?
Wayzz: Marinette, you must come with me! Master Fu needs you! (turns around and phases out of the window)
Marinette: (to Tikki) Do you think it's serious?

scene: The subway. Marinette rushes inside the train and takes a seat
conversation:
Marinette: (shuffles inside her purse to find a piece of paper and a pen) I'm gonna write Adrien a letter, and give it to him on the train platform just before he leaves. At least then I won't mess up anything when I open my mouth! (puts the tip of the pen atop the paper, takes a deep breath and commences writing)
Marinette: "Dearest you, when you love someone you must never hold back from telling them when you have the chance, (two boys hear Marinette and listen in) because one day you might realize that it's too late and that all your hopes and dreams are ruined, with no way to go back in time and do it over. (comic starts running in the background) I want to tell it to you today, before you leave, so you can take my words with you. I'm hoping they'll make their way to your heart, and that when you come back, you'll give me a chance to prove how true these words really are. I... love you." (comic ends)
Boys: (mocking her) I looooveee you!

scene: Right outside Fu's massage shop, Marinette is climbing down the staircase, when she comes to an abrupt halt
conversation:
Marinette: You can count on me, Wayzz! (exits)
Marinette: Hey, wait! Adrien's train is leaving at— (takes her phone out) Oh no! That's in 20 minutes!
Tikki: The meds, Master Fu's letter, Adrien's letter. You won't have enough time to do everything, Marinette!
Marinette: I won't have time, but (we) might!

scene: Right outside Fu's massage shop, Marinette is climbing down the staircase, when she comes to an abrupt halt
conversation:
Marinette: I won't have time, but (we) might!
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (transforms into Ladybug)
Ladybug: (hides behind the building) Spots off! (transforms back into Marinette)

scene: At the Gare du Nord train station. Ladybug comes swinging on her yo-yo
conversation:
Marinette: (rushes away) Sorry! (bumps into someone) Ugh! Medical emergency!
Marinette: (hides behind the building once again) I did it! I gave him the letter! I actually did it, after all this time! Why did I wait so long? It was so easy!
Tikki: I'm so proud of you, Marinette! You were right to take the plunge
Marinette: All right! Time for the next one! Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug and swings away on her yo-yo)

scene: Outside Collège Françoise Dupont. The girls are gathered around Marinette
conversation:
Mylène: Did you tell him?
Marinette: Yeah... (awkwardly rubs her arm) I mean... kind of. Basically, I gave him a letter. (The girls start cheering)

Marinette: (awkwardly) Oh, not much, it's not really important, is it?

scene: Outside Collège Françoise Dupont. The girls are gathered around Marinette
conversation:
Adrien: Uh. Hey, Marinette! (Alya pushes Marinette in front of Adrien.)
Marinette: (squeals nervously) Hey
Adrien: I was very surprised when I read your letter, but since it seemed to be so important, I spent the whole weekend walking around London looking for it. (holds out a medical bag as the girls shriek in astonishment) For you. (Alya helps Marinette get the pharmacist medical bag)
Marinette: (embarrassed) Thank you
Adrien: I'm glad I could help. (walks into the school)
Marinette: (Disaster!) (collapses)

scene: Outside Collège Françoise Dupont. The girls are gathered around Marinette
conversation:
Alix: Open it!
Marinette: No, we're good. (shifts the bag out of the girls' reach as they try to take it) Trust me, you really don't need to open it
Alya: (confused) Constipation capsules?
Marinette: (mortified gasp) Ah, uh, I... (bends her head low)

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is watching the news on her computer while knitting a sweater.
conversation:
Tikki: But how is the train going across the sea between France and the UK, Marinette?
Marinette: Well, there's a tunnel under the English Channel, Tikki
Tikki: Did a superhero do that?
Marinette: (laughs) No, just regular men with machines
Tikki: I can't believe how many inventions humans have made since I last had an owner
Marinette: There's no stopping progress, Tikki
Tikki: There's no stopping you, either. This is gonna be a wonderful sweater!
Marinette: It's a tradition, you know. I always knit my dad a sweater every year for his birthday, so I wanna do something extra special for him this time around, but I couldn't think of anything
Tikki: I'm sure you'll come up with a perfect idea. You always do
Marinette: I'd better think of it now, 'cause his birthday is today!

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette calls Gina via video chat.
conversation:
Gina: Mmm, oh, he's always lived in the past. Well, it's complicated. If you really want to know about it, you should probably ask your dad or your mom
Marinette: Oh, okay, thanks Grandma, see you tonight. (hangs up and groans) Seriously, why won't anyone just answer me?! (suddenly gets an idea and jumps onto her computer)
Tikki: Judging by that look on your face, I'm thinking that you've come up with your idea
Marinette: You're right, Tikki. I know exactly what I'm getting for my dad for his birthday! I'm gonna get him and his dad back together again! I found Roland Dupain's address, let's go!
Tikki: What are you waiting for, Marinette?
Marinette: If I tell him who I am right away, he won't listen to me, just like with mom. (rings doorbell)

scene: Outside Roland Dupain's house. Marinette is in front of the outside gate.
conversation:
Roland: Oh! Come in, come in! The door's open
Marinette: (gasps, and runs to open the gate for him) Hello! I'm Marinette, Mr. Dupain's granddaughter! I was just about to go in, myself. You can leave me the sack, I'll bring it to him. It'll be a nice surprise
Gilbert: Roland has a granddaughter?
Marinette: He sure does! (Gilbert smiles and hands her the sack. She groans under its weight.)

Marinette: Oh no! It's... light. Could I borrow your cap? I wanna play a prank on Grandpa
Gilbert: (puts his company cap on her head) Say hi to Roland for me! I'll grab my cap next time I come by! (He hops in his van and drives away, while Marinette struggles up the stairs.)

scene: Outside Roland Dupain's house. Marinette is in front of the outside gate.
conversation:
Marinette: Don't worry, I know how it's done. (she starts kneading it, and Roland sets down the sack) You take the dough and fold it in half, rhythmically, pressing it flat
Roland and Marinette: snapping it slightly- oh! Huh? (they look at each other)
Marinette: It gives it elasticity and develops the gluten in the dough, so that it holds together well after it's been baked

scene: Roland's Kitchen.
conversation:
Roland: (sinisterly) You can count on me, Hawk Moth. (A purple ether engulfs him, and his mice run away).)

Marinette: No! Grandpa!
Bakerix: (Bakerix's bread muscles expand.) Yah! (Marinette whimpers. He breaks through the walls of the house, and leaps out into the city.)
Marinette: We'll finish the baking later! (runs into the kitchen and turns off the oven)

scene: Roland's Kitchen.
conversation:
Marinette: We'll finish the baking later! (runs into the kitchen and turns off the oven)
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (turns into Ladybug)

scene: Roland's House.
conversation:

Marinette: (by the oven) Grandpa? Cat Noir? Is everything okay?

Marinette: You see? I (do) know how it's done

conversation:
Cat Noir: (his ring beeps) Uh, the thing is, I'm gonna transform back soon, and- whoa! (Roland pushes him toward the bread) You're a real tough cookie, even without your superpowers. (he tries both loaves) Mmm. Both these breads are delicious, d'you have any jam by any chance?
Roland and Marinette: That's not how you taste bread! (Roland smiles at her)
Cat Noir: They're both tasty, in different ways. This one's more traditional, and this one has a delicate flavor that makes it special. It's too hard to choose. (his ring beeps rapidly) I'm sorry but I really do have to get going. (runs to the front door) Thanks for the tasty snack! (leaps out)

conversation:
Marinette: Are you kidding? He hates it! He has no reason to listen to it unless... He's making a playlist for my surprise party! Elementary

Marinette: Which means... He's going to be there!

conversation:

Tom: Uh, oh, uh... Party? Uh, what party? Uh, which Alya, again?

conversation:

Tom: (sticking his head around the corner) Mom?

conversation:

conversation:

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie, Bakery
conversation:
Gina: You think she doesn't want to spend time with her Nonna, is that it?

conversation:

conversation:

(she attempts to fire her gun again, but it is empty, forcing her to reload from the bag at her waist) Don't worry. You'll get what's coming to you
Marinette: (she crawls quickly under a table) This isn't how I envisioned my birthday party
Tikki: (as the table turns to coal) You need to transform!

scene: The Place des Vosges
conversation:
Marinette: Alya!
Marinette: No, Kim!

conversation:

Marinette: Tikki, spots-

scene: Eiffel Tower
conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

scene: Seine
conversation:

conversation:

scene: Seine
conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

scene: Near the Agreste Mansion
conversation:

Marinette: Tikki, spots on!
Ladybug: (gasps) Adrien's trophies... Adrien's basketball hoop... Adrien's foosball table... (lightly brushes her hand against his desk) Adrien's desk... Adrien's video games... (lies on his bed) Adrien's bed

scene: Alternate Paris, full of destruction
conversation:
Cat Blanc: Give me a hug... (
MARINETTE!!!!: )
Ladybug: You're wrong! I'm not Marinette! (seen from burrow) It's impossible, I never told you anything!'

scene: Burrow
conversation:

scene: Burrow
conversation:

scene: Burrow
conversation:

scene: Burrow
conversation:

Marinette: No. I don't love you... (anymore!) (runs away crying)
Adrien: No... Marinette! (runs after her, but his bodyguard won't let him in, to his bodyguard) Please let me through, it can't end like this! It can't end at all! I love her!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont
conversation:
Bunnyx: Even if I did, I couldn't tell you. There's a time for everything and time is a fragile thing. That's the reason you picked me, Minibug. I know how to keep a secret. (enters Burrow)
Marinette: He wasn't home. His fencing competition probably ended later than expected
Alya: What did you do with the gift?
Marinette: Oh, I dropped it off at home before coming back here. I was gonna tell you that I've given it to him but the truth is I just couldn't do it! But I promise next time, it'll work. You know what they say, 563rd time's a charm! (Marinette’s friends hug her)

scene: Marinette's room.
conversation:
Marinette: Dear Diary: Oh wow, we avoided a disaster today! Cat Noir and I had just arrested a supervillain, but because I'd already used my Lucky Charm, there wasn't much time left! I almost transformed back right there under Cat Noir's nose! So I ran to a safe place as fast as I could, to change back to me, Marinette, without anyone seeing—and making sure Cat Noir hadn't followed me. I think he'd love to know who I am… he's so nosy! There's no way I'm letting that happen! No one can find out. Ugh, Cat Noir, we haven’t known each other very long, but it feels like we’ve been together forever!
Ladybug: (I thought cats always landed on their feet.)

scene: Early morning. Rooftops of Paris. Ladybug heads into Marinette's Bedroom and transforms back to Marinette.
conversation:

Adrien: That villain was so tough. (Plagg yawns and falls onto the bed with Adrien)

Remember when I told you I made a terrible mistake? For you to understand, I must tell you the entire story. (as Master Fu explains, a montage of what happened is shown) I was younger than you when I was chosen to be a Guardian. My parents told me that it was a great honor. That I couldn't turn it down. So they took me to the temple. I wasn't very happy there. I would have preferred to live with my parents and be with other children my age. I didn't want to be a guardian of anything. One of the test to become a Guardian required me to watch over a Miracle Box. For a full twenty-four hours without any food. All I had for support was my apprentice's staff. Soon I was hungry. With each passing hour I became hungrier. And it was all because of the Miraculous. Because I had to watch over them. I couldn't take it any longer. So I took the Peacock Miraculous and used its power. All I wanted was a nice little companion I could sent to the kitchen to fetch me some rice balls. But the Miraculous must never be used for the wrong reasons. The anger I was feeling mingled with my intense hunger. And I created a Sentimonster that was very different from the one I had envisioned. A ravenous Sentimonster out to devour everything, but specifically the Miraculous, since they were the bane of my life at that very moment. In my panic, I lost my staff. The very object that would have enabled me to control it. I was just a young boy. I was so afraid I didn't even think of destroying it by simply using the Peacock Miraculous. I tried to erase all traces of the foolish thing that I had done. A monk told me to run away with the grimoire he managed to save and the Miraculous Box. The very last Miraculous Box. That's when I realized my Sentimonster had devoured all the other Miraculous Boxes that were kept in the temple. And when the monks tried to stop it... the temple, the Order of the Guardians, everything, it was destroyed. I tried to run away from the Sentimonster. But by doing so, I lost the grimoire and both the Butterfly and the Peacock Miraculous. I thought the Sentimonster had disappeared forever. conversation:

conversation:

scene: Gare du Nord.
conversation:
Wang Fu: The bat and the red beetle were incredible! Paris is always filled with good people ready to devote themselves for the greater good. Like you, Marinette

Su-Han: (upset) Involving Marianne in the fight - a human without powers was against the precepts too. (Marinette is surprised) The second thing is that your natural instincts tell you who you can trust, an essential quality for a Guardian. Whiny Chicken- uh, sorry... Master Fu may not have made such a bad choice after all. (Marinette smiles) The Miracle Box is the mother of all boxes. It's the very first one that was created, and the one that holds the most powerful magic jewels. I cannot imagine what would happen if it were to fall into the wrong hands. (Marinette nods as she walks over to her special hiding place for the box, inputs the code, and sets it inside) I will make the most of my time here in Paris to get accustomed to modern life. How can I be a good guardian if I don't try to understand the world around me?

conversation:

conversation:

Bob: That's right! Requested by Jagged Stone himself. (pulls out an XY album) I brought a few visuals so you can get a sense of what we're going for
Marinette: (looks at album design) This doesn't seem like Jagged Stone material. More like...a perfume ad!
Bob: This is the direction of his new image. More modern, current!
Marinette: really? Wow. I was thinking more along the lines of–
Bob: (interrupts Marinette) Don't think! (This) is what is selling these days
Marinette: Uh...sure
Bob: And one last thing, Marinette. We're in a hurry! We need your proposal by the end of the day. You up to it?
Marinette: (looks at her parents, who nod reassuringly) Uh, yeah! Okay
Bob: (leaves the bakery) See you later, then!

scene: Le Grand Paris. Marinette presents her design to Jagged Stone in front of Bob and Penny.
conversation:
Jagged: Doesn't it look a lot like the cover of that YZ guy? Marinette, don't listen to Bob. Could you do another one? You know, Jagged style?
Marinette: (hesitantly) Yeah, sure! (Bob puts a hand on her shoulder) But I don't know if–
Jagged: (holds Marinette's hands) You're my girl, Marinette. Remember: raw, impulsive artistry. I think we're all done here, Bob

scene: Outside Le Grand Paris. Marinette is walking while looking at the cover of XY's album.
conversation:
Chloé: Sooo, you get a private meeting with your favorite star. He's staying right here in Daddy's hotel! Is Chloé the best, or is Chloé the best?
Marinette: (to Tikki) Did you hear that?
Tikki: Chloé speaking in the third person? Totally annoying!
Marinette: No! The part where Adrien likes Jagged just like me! Now I definitely can't mess up the artwork
Tikki: So, now what?
Marinette: I'm going to design Jagged Stone's next album (my) way, and no one else's
Tikki: Way to go, Marinette! Follow your instinct!

scene: Inside Le Grand Paris. Chloé and Adrien are waiting for the elevator.
conversation:
Marinette: I've gotta transform! (hides behind a tree)
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
Ladybug: Cat Noir, you okay?

scene: Le Grand Hotel. Marinette presents her second design to Jagged Stone in front of Bob and Penny.
conversation:
Jagged: (interrupts Bob) Fine, then I'm outta here! I'm sure another record company will be perfectly happy with the #2 chart topper
Marinette: Yee-haw! Tikki, I can't believe I've just designed a cover for Jagged Stone's new album!
Tikki: I'm so proud of you, Marinette! (Marinette chuckles)

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Marinette and Alya are hanging out near the stairs, looking through the magazines.
conversation:
Adrien: Um... hey there, Marinette. (Marinette tries to stay cool, but she almost trips) So, actually I'm a huge fan of Jagged Stone's and I saw you designed his new album cover
Marinette: I...I did! (chuckles) Crazy, huh?
Adrien: I... wanted to ask if... I could get it... autographed?
Marinette: Um, okay, sure... uh, I'll ask him. (grabs Adrien's marker and album cover)
Adrien: Ah, no. Um, actually I meant (you). (he points to her)
Marinette: (realizes everyone is watching her) Me? Me? (signs her name on the cover)
Adrien: If you wouldn't mind. (Marinette gives the marker and album cover back to him) Awesome! Thanks, Marinette! (walks away while looking at Marinette's signature)

scene: Marinette's room. Tom enters the trapdoor.
conversation:
Tom: Don't make me do this alone. (closes the trapdoor)
Marinette: (groans) I used up an entire month's worth of excuses in one go and it's still wasn't enough! What am I gonna do? Ladybug can't abandon Paris!
Tikki: You can't abandon your family either, Marinette!
Marinette: (groans louder and goes down from her bunk bed) I'll have to come up with a better excuse on the way. (The kwamis fly to her before she goes downstairs.) You stay here and be good. I'll be back

scene: Marinette's room. Tom enters the trapdoor.
conversation:
Marinette: (groans louder and goes down from her bunk bed) I'll have to come up with a better excuse on the way. (The kwamis fly to her before she goes downstairs.) You stay here and be good. I'll be back
Marinette: (from downstairs) Ow! I must've twisted my ankle! There's no way I can walk anywhere like this!
Tom: (from downstairs) I'll carry you, sweetie, don't worry

scene: Interior, Gare du Nord.
conversation:
Sabine: Marinette! Don't try to run away. I know my sister can be difficult. But if I survived my whole childhood with her, you can survive one weekend!
Marinette: Mom, I just really need a hug from Alya. She's my BFF, you know?
Sabine: Alright, but make it quick. The train's about to leave
Marinette: (while running towards Alya) I don't think we have a choice, Tikki

scene: Interior, Gare du Nord.
conversation:
Alya: You can't leave Paris. What do we do if there's a supervillain and you're in London?
Marinette: Well, we'll do... (takes off her earrings and hands it over to Alya, along with her keys) this
Alya: What do you expect me to do with these??
Marinette: If everything goes fine, nothing. Otherwise, Ladybug. And don't forget to feed the kwamis. (hugs Alya) I trust you. (runs to enter the train)

scene: In the train. Marinette sends Alya a message.
conversation:
Nino: Uhh... super, I guess?
Marinette: (v.o) Protip 33: When Cat Noir tells a joke, try to laugh at it even if it isn't funny. It makes him happy
Tom: (to Sabine) We can have lunch, but we don't have to stay for dessert

scene: In the train. Marinette sends Alya a message.
conversation:

Marinette: (v.o) Pro-tip 34
Gabriel: Hack-San behaves like a computer virus

scene: In the train. Marinette continues to send protips to Alya.
conversation:

Marinette: (v.o) Protip 675: Once you've called out "Miraculous Ladybug", don't forget to give them the magical charm. That's all. X-O-X-O
Tom and Marinette: It's not our fault! Promise!
Marinette: There's something weird— Don't pick up!!

scene: In the train. Marinette continues to send protips to Alya.
conversation:
Tom: Marinette
Marinette: (panics) Alya, I'm counting on you! (continues to escape)
Tom: You're what we hold most valuable

scene: Flashbacks from Gamer, The camera slowly drifts into Marinette's room as she writes in her diary.
conversation:

conversation:

Robostus: AHAHAHAHAHAHAH, you really thought you can control me? [Robostus creates a spreading incorporal globe of data that hacks Hawk Moth's lair]

scene: Continuing narration: Ladybug and Cat Noir sitting together, in view of the Eiffel Tower.
conversation:

Marinette: Others lose patience

conversation:

Luka: ((continues humming, hands pizza to customer)) That's it! I got it! ((to customer) Gotta go, enjoy your meal. ((returns to bike)

scene: In the kitchen: Adrien and Kagami hide from Bodyguard.
conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

((Takes a breath, crying)) of never being able to be who I truly am. ((continues crying))

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

Marinette: Totally unbelievable

Adrien: Don't worry, you'll do fine

scene: Classroom. Marinette looks at Adrien.
conversation:

Marinette: I'm not scared of that monster, officer Jones!
Chloé: (gasp) CUT!!! I knew it!

scene: Classroom. Marinette looks at Adrien.
conversation:

Rose: A fruity snack for the road?

conversation:

You're right, Tikki! If I stick with her, I can make us lose. And then Adrien would never see Kagami win and they'll never fall in love
Tikki: Uh, come to think of it, perhaps it would be better for you not to go

conversation:

Marinette: (hides behind a tree before recording a video herself) I'm with Kagami, can you (believe) this? Go for the win, 'cause there's no way I'm gonna let us find Adrien as long as I'm with her. (stops the recording and sends it to Alya)

scene: Jardin des Tuileries. Marinette crashes down on a bench and sighs.
conversation:

Tikki: 30 tips for making friends

Tikki: Do all humans really sneak through other people's things? (Marinette smiles guilty) You better run!

conversation:
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Ikari Gozen, I am Hawk Moth
Marinette: Ma'am, please don't punish your daughter. Ma'am? Hello?
Tomoe: (through phone) With pleasure, Hawk Moth
Marinette: I'm sorry, I really did try to smooth things over but I think your mom's super-duper angry now and will be looking for you. I actually think you might wanna hide someplace where she won't find you

scene: Jardin des Tuileries, back where they separated. Kagami is slowly walking towards the sprinting Marinette.
conversation:

Marinette: I was completely wrong about Kagami

conversation:

Marinette: As elusive as the wind, as powerful as the flood, as swift as lightning. Yeah! (she picks up the Dragon Miraculous) I hope you enjoy the show, master

conversation:

scene: Marinette's room
conversation:

Marinette: Sorry

conversation:

conversation:

Psycomedian: Where are you running to, Bob?

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

scene: At a nearby flower shop
conversation:
Marinette: Thank you!
Marinette: This one please! (Pointing at flower bouquet with pink roses and white flowers) Hurry hurry hurry hurry hurry

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

Marinette: Give me that card!

Marinette: Give me the card or I'll keep your phone!
Chloé: Ha! You can keep the phone! I'll just buy another one!

scene: Principal Damoclès' office. Marinette is still hiding under the desk, Chloé and Sabrina are searching for her.
conversation:
Marinette: (runs into the library) Time to transform, Tikki!
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug)
Reflekta: You won't get rid of me by locking me in the bathroom this time!

conversation:
Adrien: This photo was a good idea, Marinette!
Marinette: (blushes) Thanks Adrien!
Chloé: Like I would want to be part of their stupid photo anyway! Ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous!

scene: Paris, on the Eiffel Tower. Fireworks are continued to be set off for the end-of-the-school-year dance. A heartbroken Marinette walks to the tower's elevator, her make-up still looking messed up, following the finale of "Revolution".
conversation:
Tikki: (worried) Marinette, are you sure you want to go...?
Marinette: We fought so hard for a happy ending, Tikki. (wipes her tears) We have to go to this dance, if only for my friends' sake
Tikki: You're so brave... Is there anything I can do?
Marinette: Do you know a surefire trick to keep from crying?
Tikki: If I did, I'd use it on myself
Marinette: (breathes deeply) I won't cry. I won't cry. (fans her face with both her hands as she holds back her tears) I won't cry. With a little luck, no one will even notice me

scene: Back on the Eiffel Tower, Argos and Kagami contemplates on their plan with Marinette.
conversation:
Mylène: (gives Marinette a small piece of log with a ribbon) Thanks to you, if Miss Bustier is elected, there will be more trees, less cars — the planet will breathe!
Marinette: (walks away backwards from Ivan and Mylène) I'm happy that the planet gets to breathe. But right now, (I'm) the one who can't breathe! (runs) Adrien!
Mylène: Are you sure you're okay, Marinette?

scene: Back on the Eiffel Tower, Argos and Kagami contemplates on their plan with Marinette.
conversation:
Marinette: Who, me? (hides her face behind the bouquet she's holding) Of course not! Adrien!
Marinette: (dejected) There's no way... (sits on the floor and attempts to contact Adrien)
Adrien's voicemail: Hello! You've reached Adrien's voicemail, leave a message!

scene: Back on the Eiffel Tower, Argos and Kagami contemplates on their plan with Marinette.
conversation:
Alya: You have the right to be sad, Marinette. This is anything but the ending we expected
Marinette: Oh! I just remembered! (stands up) I forgot a giant cookie that I made for the party! So, I'm going to go get it! I'll be right back!
Alya: That was the worst lie she's ever fed me

scene: Downtown Paris. Marinette is seen to be continuously chasing after Adrien on the streets, and continuously bumping onto people as well.
conversation:
Marinette: Sorry!
Marinette: Adrien! (sobs as she hugs the piece of paper)
Duusu: It's so sad!

scene: Back to Kagami and Félix's storytelling, Kagami, acting as Colt, is seen sitting on a chair begrudgingly.
conversation:
Félix: ﻿﻿﻿The miraculous child did not understand. (takes off his mask for sincerity) ﻿Why didn't his father love him?
Marinette: ﻿﻿﻿﻿Félix?
Félix: (reaches out to what is depicted to be Colt's hand on the hospital bed with a cardboard heart rate monitor beeping) ﻿﻿﻿﻿And why did he feel obligated to obey all his orders, ("Colt" places his hand out of Félix's reach) ﻿no matter how unfair they might be?

scene: In the art classroom, Kagami and Félix's storytelling slowly comes to a close.
conversation:
Kagami: (﻿She's) the only one who can face the tailor. ﻿'Cause she's the only one who can fix things
Marinette: ﻿(shocked) Me...?
Kagami: (v.o.) ﻿You know what it's like to not love the one you want

scene: In the art classroom, Kagami and Félix's storytelling slowly comes to a close.
conversation:
Kagami: (v.o.) ﻿You have to lie all the time, and never reveal who you really are
Marinette: I'll help you
Argos: ﻿Will she have the courage to face the father of the boy she loves?

scene: Exterior, Dupain-Cheng Residence. Cat Noir lands on the balcony railing as he stares at the trapdoor to Marinette's room.
conversation:
Marinette: (after hanging her dress on the mirror) ﻿That's because it's not just a fairy tale, my Tikki. (unplugs her phone from her charger) ﻿And it's not finished yet
Marinette: ﻿Seems like Cat Noir's had a busy night. ﻿Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug)
Adrien: ﻿You were right, Plagg. ﻿I can't tell Marinette that I'm Cat Noir. ﻿And I can't disobey my father either. (pauses) ﻿You saw the result. (leans on the railing) I can't stay here. ﻿Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir...) ﻿Power up. (...and into Astrocat)

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, courtyard. Adrien and Marinette walk inside the school grounds together, hand-in-hand, and are greeted by students gossiping about the new Alliance avatar update.
conversation:
Adrien: Doesn't matter. These avatars are just images, Rose. They're not really us
Marinette: His father can always try to force his truth on us, but we know ours. And so does Kagami
Ms. Bustier: (upon giving the paper back to Mylène) Excellent work, Mylène! (walks to Chloé and Sabrina's table) Now, however... these two papers I had a small issue with, as they both bear Sabrina's name

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, in Ms. Bustier's classroom. Ms. Bustier is giving back the class' exam papers.
conversation:
Ms. Bustier: Alright. Sabrina, I'm going to give you your real grade. Just don't do it again. You mustn't exhaust yourself in Chloé's service. You need your energy for yourself, too! (Sabrina nods.) As for you, Chloé, it's been so long since you've done any original work that you must've fallen way behind. You're going to need a lot of help!
Marinette: That's unfair, Ms. Bustier! Everybody knows that Chloé's been cheating — taking advantage of Sabrina and not making any efforts compared to the others... for years! And the only consequence is that she's going to get help?? Of course, we need to support students who have problems, but not when (they're) the problem!
Ms. Bustier: At school, Chloé is like everyone else, Marinette. Her falling behind will be punishment enough

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, in Ms. Bustier's classroom. Ms. Bustier is giving back the class' exam papers.
conversation:
Lila: Marinette, as class representative, I guess you've already discussed Chloé's difficulties with the teachers, haven't you?
Marinette: Huh? Why would I have? She doesn't have difficulties! Only privileges! And if you need proof to see how the teachers will let her get away with anything!
Chloé: As they should! Otherwise, my father, the Mayor of Paris, would kick them out of school (for good!)

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, in Ms. Bustier's classroom. Ms. Bustier is giving back the class' exam papers.
conversation:
Lila: Because of your wonderful romance with Adrien, you no longer have time for your duties as class representative, and that makes you feel bad. Oh, if you want, I could replace you! This way, you'll be able to think exclusively about yourself without feeling guilty for betraying the trust of those who elected you
Marinette: Huh— What??? But t-t-that's out of the question!!
Lila: (stands up) It so happens that I just quit as face of Gabriel brand in order to have more time for my friends. If everyone agrees, I'm willing to give the attention that's obviously lacking to Chloé's and everyone else's issues
Marinette: If you wanted to be class rep, you should've run in the election!
Lila: Oh! That's right. I wasn't here on that day. Hmm... When you think about it, it wasn't exactly democratic to hold the elections in my absence. What do you think, Ms. Bustier?

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, in the cafeteria. Marinette walks to the table where Adrien, Alya and Nino are.
conversation:
Alya: That's super sweet of you, Adrien! But you don't have to defend Marinette, you know?
Marinette: (whispers to Adrien) You were right. We can't talk about it openly. Lila is too good a liar. They'll never believe us. (to Alya and Nino) You have to admit that holding a new class rep at the end of the school year makes no sense
Alya: Duh! Then it'd be no big deal to let Lila try and see if she can get somewhere with Chloe
Marinette: "Get somewhere with Chloé"??
Alya: Alright, fine. I'll admit that there's very little chance that Chloé will ever change. But if Lila can rid the world of such a huge dose of walking wickedness, it's worth a try, right?

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, in Ms. Bustier's classroom. The whole class enter in the classroom after finishing their lunch.
conversation:
Mylène: Can Lila actually get her to change?
Marinette: (slams her fists on her table) This is so crazy! It's all lies!!
Lila: Poor Marinette... couldn't succeed because she was too busy with her love life, as well as being reminded of her disdain for Chloé. But you know me. You know all about my humanitarian work. I'm used to going into conflict zones. I can do this. There are two weeks left... What do you have to lose? Help me, help Chloé change. Vote for me!

scene: On the streets. Hoaxer's illusion of Marinette as Monarch continues to brainwash every Parisian with their Alliances.
conversation:
Adrien: We can't reason with them. Lila hypnotized them through their Alliances. They'll believe everything! Plagg, claws out! (transforms into Cat Noir)
Marinette: (from the transmission) Another perfect opportunity to akumatize that stupid Lila! (transforms into Monarch)
Alya: I know where to find Marinette for sure, sooner or later! (glances at the bakery)

scene: Interior, the Dupain-Cheng Residence, in Marinette's room. Ladybug enters her room through her trapdoor on the balcony. She walks towards her desk.
conversation:
Alya: Hey— What are you doing??
Marinette: I need Scarabella to set a trap for Hoaxer!
Cat Noir: Let go of me!

scene: Back on the streets, Marinette confronts Hoaxer.
conversation:
Scarabella: (continues to type the message to Cat Noir from behind a chimney) I'm hiding. As soon as I catch her with my yo-yo, get ready to Cataclysm her ring. (closes her bug phone)
Marinette: You're right, Lila. I never liked you. I always thought you were a liar. But this has gone too far. I never wanted you to get akumatized. This has nothing to do with the people of Paris, or Ladybug and Cat Noir. You don't need to make everyone suffer because of me. If you want to talk, I'm ready to listen. (goes down from the cartop) Just you and me
Cat Noir: Wow... I love that girl!

scene: Back on the streets, Marinette confronts Hoaxer.
conversation:
Cat Noir: (sitting on the lamppost; to himself) Pound it, m'Lady!
Marinette: (looks up to the rooftops;to herself) Pound it, Alya!
Monarch: Dark wings, fall

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, in the courtyard. Adrien and Marinette sit beside each other on the stairs.
conversation:
Adrien: I'm sorry, Marinette. I was wrong. I shouldn't have told you to act against Lila. If you give the slightest opportunity to people like her, they'll grasp at it and cause disasters in no time. And now, you're the one who looks like a bad person
Marinette: (reaches out to hold his hand beside her) You thought you were doing the right thing. Just like with Chloe. That's another reason why I love you, Adrien. You always want to see the good in other people. But sometimes, the good we think we see in some people is just a reflection of our own, and we end up being fooled by our own kindness. (They squeeze each other's hands.) But we'll find a way to expose Lila eventually
Ms. Bustier: Here is the result of the vote: unanimously elected, Lila and Chloé!

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, in Ms. Bustier's classroom.
conversation:
Alya: (to Marinette, nudging her on her arm) I told you she was a nice girl. She rejected her Megakuma. That's proof enough, right? I'm glad you decided to trust her
Marinette: No. I decided to let her have her way so I can finally prove to you all who she really is
Lila: Your secrets are mine, and soon I'll have your Miraculous, Monarch. (closes the locker door)

scene: Île aux Cygnes. Alya and Marinette are watching a video from the Ladyblog sitting under an umbrella on a carpet on the sand.
conversation:
Alya: Now these heroes who call themselves the Miraculers help us out even when the problem is not caused by an akumatized villain. Thank you Miraculers and remember for more superheroic news, stay connected
Marinette: This is amazing Alya!
Alya: Yeah but anyone can do that. I wanna put some real journalism out there. Tell people how hard it is to be a superhero. How hard we had to train in order to evolve, to stop transforming back. I want to explain how you enhanced our miraculous when you redesigned the jewels. (sighs) But all I get to do is tell a fraction of what I know
Marinette: People might figure out you're a superhero if you didn't
Alya: I know, but you know me. I'd love to be able to tell the truth, the whole truth
Marinette: Do you wish I hadn't given you that miraculous?
Alya: Are you kidding? I love being a superhero. I would've been so mad at you if you hadn't picked me
Marinette: You never would've found out
Alya: Impossible. I'm a lie detector in the flesh

scene: Dupain-Cheng residence. The walls and windows of the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie are covered in large graffiti, depicting Marinette as a witch casting a spell on Adrien, and Marinette flying away on her broom. There's also graffiti of a black cat next to her.
conversation:
Tom: Hand me the phone Sabine. (takes the phone) I'm warning you, say one word about my daughter and
Marinette: Dad, Mom, what's going on?

scene: Dupain-Cheng residence. The walls and windows of the Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie are covered in large graffiti, depicting Marinette as a witch casting a spell on Adrien, and Marinette flying away on her broom. There's also graffiti of a black cat next to her.
conversation:

conversation:

conversation:

Marinette: No one can be this mean. We'll go talk to him

Marinette: I sent him a message and he agreed to meet with me

conversation:

Marinette: If I hadn't lied to Adrien and Alya and everyone, he couldn't have made this video
Tikki: Whether you lied or not, this Vincent Secret would have made up some other fake stories to gossip about

scene: Dupain-Cheng's Residence, Marinette's bedroom
conversation:

Marinette: What time is it?
Tikki: Almost 9

scene: Café Crème, exterior
conversation:

conversation:

Vincent: See? You don't know exactly

conversation:

Marinette: (in video) I hate this guy

conversation:

scene: Dupain-Cheng residence, Marinettes bedroom
conversation:

Marinette: Mm-hmm
Nadja Chamack: Who really is famous influencer Vincent Secret? A promising young journalist just unveiled the truth

scene: On the streets. Revelator runs across the rooftops, he drops down in front of a civilian.
conversation:
Ladybug: No! Rena!
Marinette: I couldn't tell Adrien the truth. He would have been completely ruined if he found out that Monarch was his own father
Cat Noir: Uh-oh...she just discovered your secret identity, huh? But that's okay, your Miraculous Ladybug will erase everything right, m'lady?

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Marc is hiding under the stair case, writing in his journal.
conversation:
Marinette: Hey Marc. How's it going? Where is the rest of your class?
Marc: Oh, hey, Marinette. We're done with classes for today, the others probably went home
Marinette: Perfect timing! Our class has a spare hour, so some of us are heading over to the art room. You should come check it out!
Marc: (unsure) Sure... Why not?
Marinette: (Peeks over Marc's shoulder, looking at the book) Maybe you'll finally let me read your writing!
Marc: (unsure) Yeah, I don't know? Maybe
Marinette: Awesome! See you later then. (Giggles and runs up the stairs)

scene: School Restroom. Marinette runs into the restroom into a toilet stall with Marc's book.
conversation:
Marinette: (Narrating) I saw the Evillustrator again today. Now that he's no longer controlled by Hawk Moth, he's become a true superhero, like Cat Noir and me. I'm sure he'd make an awesome partner, but I'm too shy to ask him. And I don't want to Cat Noir about it either, because I'm worried he'll be jealous
Marinette: It's not exactly the truth, but it's definitely a fun read
Tikki: Do you realize, Marinette? Ladybug has become a source of inspiration! You're a lucky charm for artists everywhere
Marinette: Marc writes exactly the kind of stories that Nate draws! It's incredible! They're (totally) meant to work together

scene: School lockers. Marc is digging through his stuff in his locker, desperately trying to find something.
conversation:
Marinette: Marc writes exactly the kind of stories that Nate draws! It's incredible! They're (totally) meant to work together
Marinette: Looking for this?
Marc: (relieved) Oh. (gasps) Did you read it?
Marinette: Oh, no! ([pause] (sighs) Yeah... sorry. It was too tempting
Marc: (Turns his back to Marinette) Oh, how embarrassing. So, so, lame
Marinette: No, it's not! You should turn it into a comic book. Why don't you team up with Nathaniel?
Marc: Uhh, I'm sure he won't like it
Marinette: You should have him read it before you jump to conclusions
Marc: But what if he doesn't like it? (Buries face in book) I'll be so embarrassed. I'll have to change schools so I'll never run into him again
Marinette: Now you're being silly. Look, he draws Ladybug all the time and you write stories about her. Oh, I've got an idea; we'll have him read it without telling him who wrote it. If he like's it, it's a win-win. If he doesn't, we just won't say anything
Marc: Do you think it'll work?
Marinette: (nods) Trust me on this

scene: School Art Room. Marinette is sitting at a table with Marc's book.
conversation:
Marinette: (nods) Trust me on this
Marinette: Nate! (puts book down) Someone gave me this for you
Nathaniel: Who's someone?
Marinette: I can't tell you who just yet. (whispering) It's a secret. (starts running off, but turns around) Read it, "(Winks)" and then we'll talk. (starts running again)
Nathaniel: (gasps) Diary of Ladybug!? (covers mouth) Is this... for real?

scene: School entrance. Marinette is awaiting Nathaniel
conversation:
Marinette: Just do as I say, not as I do, okay?
Marinette: (to Nathaniel, who's reading as he walks out the school) How's it going? (Nathaniel goes up to her) Nate? So.. what did you think?
Nathaniel: It's seriously amazing! But how did you get a hold of it?
Marinette: First, I need to know if you're willing to meet the person who wrote it and then trusted it to me
Nathaniel: (looks suspicious) Is it... who I think it is?
Marinette: I can't tell you anything. Please don't insist
Nathaniel: Sure. (winks) Of course
Marinette: Awesome! You're gonna make someone (very) happy

scene: School entrance. Marinette is awaiting Nathaniel
conversation:
Marinette: Awesome! You're gonna make someone (very) happy
Marinette: You keep it. You can give it back to the (author) later today. In person
Nathaniel: (to himself) It's my dream come true. This isn't some kind of prank, is it, Marinette?

scene: Marinette's balcony. Marinette uses her phone's camera to zoom in on the park, where Nathaniel is arriving.
conversation:
Marinette: Meet at the Place des Vosges Square Fountain. Trust me, you will (not) be disappointed
Marinette: Final phase of operation "Comic Book", Tikki
Tikki: This will be better than a fairy tale ending

scene: Marinette's balcony. Marinette uses her phone's camera to zoom in on the park, where Nathaniel is arriving.
conversation:
Nathaniel: Marinette? (He looks over to Marinette's balcony, where he sees her filming him)
Marinette: Uhh, operation "Comic Book" has hit a snag! (Tikki hides)
Nathaniel: You were trying to make a fool of me, weren't you? (Points accusingly towards Marinette) Do you think it's funny to toy with my feelings?

scene: Marinette's balcony. Marinette uses her phone's camera to zoom in on the park, where Nathaniel is arriving.
conversation:
Marc: Ah!
Marinette: (Watching through cellphone) Oh no! (She runs off with Tikki)
Hawk Moth: A blooming friendship brutally ripped up. Picture perfect no more. (Turns butterfly into an akuma) Fly away, my beautiful akuma, and evilize him!

conversation:
Marc: Nothing will be the same anymore, Hawk Moth
Marinette: (Arrives sprinting) Marc? What happened?
Reverser: I'm not Marc anymore. (He flies around on his paper plane) I am Reverser! And you, Marinette, the one who caused all this! You think you're the super helpful girl who's loved by everyone? Well, from now on, everyone will hate you! (grabs a paper plane) Reversion! (throws paper plane)

scene: Place des Vosges. The akuma approaches Marc and goes into one of the loose papers of his book.
conversation:
Reverser: (noticed Marinette's no longer there)
MARINETTE!!!: (flies off)
Marinette: Where did operation "Comic Book" go wrong? We better find out!

scene: Interior, the Agreste mansion, in Adrien's room. Adrien looks at a photo of Marinette in his phone
conversation:
Adrien: You're right! Now's the right time! (answers the call) Marinette, I—
Marinette: (on-call) Have you watched the news?
Adrien: Huh? (grabs the remote and turns on his TV)

scene: Exterior, in front of Collège Françoise Dupont. Adrien is seen standing before the school
conversation:
Adrien: That's for sure, Nino
Marinette: We're not letting Chloé call the shots!
Queen Mayor: (while walking into the school alongside reporters) Thanks to me, who rid you of those super-duds, Paris is going to become super-fab again! You'll get to do whatever you want to do and say whatever you want to say

scene: Exterior, in front of Collège Françoise Dupont. Adrien is seen standing before the school
conversation:
Sabrina: We're not taking the school hostage
Marinette: We're just protesting!
Chloé: They're not respecting decromancy— detromacy— (groans) You know what I mean!

scene: Pont des Arts. Adrien walks, filled with determination once more, towards Marinette, who is buying an ice cream from André
conversation:
André: Savor it. It might be my last cone
Marinette: (grabs the ice cream from Andre) No way, Andre! No one can keep you from bringing everyone so much happiness
Adrien: You okay, Nino?

scene: Interior, the Agreste mansion, in Adrien's room. Adrien paces back and forth while calling Marinette on his phone
conversation:
Queen Mayor: Oh, you miss them already? Why don't you go join them... in detention?!
Marinette's voicemail: It's Marinette! Leave a message. Beep!
Plagg: You two are definitely having a hard time communicating lately

scene: Queen Mayor's "detention". Adrien is de-immobilzed in a white arena that switches from being bathed with red to white light depending on the surrounding screens
conversation:
Adrien: (off-screen) Marinette!
Marinette: (hears Adrien at last) Adrien? Adrien!
Queen Mayor: (from the screens; red) Ridiculous! You'll always be ridiculous!

scene: Exterior, the Louvre. Queen Mayor stands in front of a podium on a stage before a large crowd of Parisians with lights directed at her
conversation:
Miss Bustier: (gasps) But I can't. I'm just a teacher!
Marinette: No, she's right! You'd be amazing!
Nino: We'll help you with your campaign, Comrade— I mean, Miss Bustier!

scene: Exterior, the Louvre. Queen Mayor stands in front of a podium on a stage before a large crowd of Parisians with lights directed at her
conversation:
