scene: Interior, the Dupain-Cheng’s Residence, in Marinette’s room. Marinette is still seen lying on her bed.
conversation:
Marinette: And I… before anything else, (looks at one of her earrings in her hand) I’ll always be…
Marinette: I… I will… I’ll always be… I’ll always be a failure; (frustratingly lies back on her bed) living a life, never succeeding what I always had to do!
Adrien: (clenches his hand on the mouth of the trash bin and stands up, determined) I don’t care, Marinette! I love you just the way you are!
Marinette: I… don’t… love you. I’ve had feelings for you Adrien, but… I don’t anymore. It’s better that way

scene: Interior, Collège Françoise Dupont, by the corridor. A worried Zoé calls Marinette.
conversation:
Marinette: I… don’t… love you. I’ve had feelings for you Adrien, but… I don’t anymore. It’s better that way
Marinette’s voicemail: (feebly) Leave a message after the beep. Beeeeep
Zoé: Alya, did you hear Marinette’s voicemail message?

scene: Interior, the Dupain-Cheng’s Residence, in Marinette’s room.
conversation:
Plagg: Someone will succeed you. You won’t have to hide anything anymore from the ones you love. You can finally be yourself
Marinette: You don’t have to do this, Tikki!
Tikki: This means you can finally be in love with Adrien

scene: Exterior, Collège Françoise Dupont. Zoé activates her Alliance ring.
conversation:
Zoé: (perturbed) Alliance, please call Marinette
Marinette’s voicemail: (feebly) Leave a message after the beep. Beeeeep
Zoé: (upon stopping in front of Marinette’s house) Marinette, it’s Zoé. I know how complicated love can be. I’ll be outside your building if you want to talk. (turns off her Alliance ring)

scene: Interior, the Dupain-Cheng’s Residence, in Marinette’s room. Adrien and Marinette stare at one another, lovesick. The two avert their eyes on each other shyly shortly after.
conversation:
Marinette: Oh! Sure— AH!
Adrien and Marinette: Oh, I’m sorry— (both gasp)
Kikou: Clout!!

scene: Interior, the Dupain-Cheng’s Residence, in Marinette’s room. Adrien and Marinette stare at one another, lovesick. The two avert their eyes on each other shyly shortly after.
conversation:
Kikou: Clout!!
Marinette: I think you're gonna have to wait a little while before you head back home
Adrien: Yeah, let’s wait until Ladybug’s taken care of this villain
Marinette: (holds her ear, realizing she doesn’t wear her Miraculous anymore) Ladybug… and Cat Noir!
Adrien: Scarabella’s back!
Marinette: But Cat Noir isn’t there
Adrien: I’m sure everything’s gonna be okay

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. A crowd of cheering Jagged Stone fans is gathered outside. Inside, Alec is introducing a television program.
conversation:
Penny: Calm down, Fang
Marinette: Are you okay, Miss Penny?
Penny: Yes, yes, it's just, this show was my idea, and Jagged's putting all his trust in me and I just hope everything goes well today

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.
conversation:
Tom: Uh...how about some chocolate croissants? (to Marinette) Can you grab a bag of flour please, dear?
Marinette: Sure, Dad! Ah! (knocks over the bag of flour. All of the flour ends up on Jagged.) Uh oh
Jagged: Hey, look! I look like a ghost! Rock and Boo-Hoo! (laughs)

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie.
conversation:
Penny: (to Marinette) Could you tell me where the restroom is, please?
Marinette: (pointing) Upstairs!
Penny: Thanks. (leads Jagged away)

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. Marinette is cleaning up.
conversation:
Jagged: (heard on TV, while the view holds on the pictures of Adrien) Aw, teenage love is so sweet! Makes me wanna write a song
Marinette: (sees the Adrien pictures on TV and gasps) No, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, (runs for the stairs)
Sabine: Marinette?
Marinette: no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no!

scene: Marinette's room. Alec is trying on Marinette's pink floppy hat, while Jagged holds up a pink dress of hers.
conversation:
Marinette: No! Not like this! (climbs the stairs into her room, and enters)
Marinette: (frantically) What're you guys doing in here?!
Penny: I'm sorry, Marinette; I couldn't find the restroom

scene: Marinette's room
conversation:
Penny: (sees the cable she broke on the floor under her foot) Sorry! (bends down to pick up the cable)
Marinette: No, Penny, get them out of here first, please!
Alec: Penny, give me that cable! We're live!

scene: Marinette's room
conversation:
Jagged: Penny, do you have a tissue? Ah-ah-ah-choo!
Marinette: Penny, no! Get out of my room first!
Bob: Penny, what is going on?

scene: Marinette's room. Tom is seen on-screen, chuckling and waving at the camera nervously.
conversation:
Tom: (turns to stare Bob in the eye, on the air) I could pretend that this isn't bothering me, but now you've gone too far, mister!
Marinette: Dad?
Sabine: (to Bob, as she wields the peel) Don't even think about laying a finger on my husband!

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette and Tikki are still watching the program.
conversation:
Troublemaker: (on the air) There's no more Penny to deal with all your problems, Jagged! From now on, there's only Troublemaker! (clicks her pen twice, briefly turning transparent) And I'll make your life nothing but problems! (cackles)
Marinette: Penny?
Tikki: That poor Penny was trying so hard to help everyone that she became a perfect victim for Hawk Moth!
Marinette: Shooting the show here definitely wasn't a good idea!

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette and Tikki are still watching the program.
conversation:
Marinette: Shooting the show here definitely wasn't a good idea!
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)
Adrien: It's time for Cat Noir to cook up a plan at the bakery!

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. Marinette enters through the rear door.
conversation:
Tom: Are you okay?
Marinette: I'm fine! I locked myself in the bathroom
Bob: Penny!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont girls' locker room. Marinette continues her stealthy creep over to her locker.
conversation:
Marinette: I just need to stay on the down-low for a few days so everyone can forget all about what happened — especially Adrien! (stands straight) Mmnh! (starts to cross the street, then hunches down into a "creeping" gait)
Marinette: (huge sigh of relief) Phew! Hopefully, he didn't see me! (shuts her locker triumphantly, only to be startled by Adrien standing behind the door, waving at her)
Adrien: Hey, Marinette! (Marinette screams) How's it going? After what happened at your place last night, I was worried that—
Marinette: (interrupting Adrien) Oh, so you watched the show, then! (laughs nervously) Well, uh, look...about what you saw on the show last night — the totographs, in my room—
Adrien: You mean the photographs?
Marinette: (assertively) The grotographs, exactly! (meekly) It-it's not what you think. (pauses) See...I'm really into fashion, and, umm
Adrien: (leaning forward with a piercing, impish glare) Are you lying?
Marinette: No! I'm so not into you—I mean, sure, I'm interested in you, but, um, not in that way; well, you know, ha-ha-ha-ha...ha ha!
Adrien: (chuckles) Just teasing. (placing his arm over her shoulder) I understand; don't worry. I've got used to having lots of fans...and, photographs of me everywhere — even in the most unlikely places
Marinette: (laughs) As if someone would have a picture of you under her bed, right?
Adrien: (takes his arm away) Yeah. I was wondering; since you're into fashion so much, you could come watch my next photo shoot!
Marinette: No way! For you?—peal—meal— For real?
Adrien: Honestly, it's pretty long and boring, but if you were there, it would definitely be more fun! Whaddaya say?
Marinette: (very excitedly, throwing her arms up) Oh wow! Yes! (containing herself) Thank you, Adrien
Adrien: I'll keep you posted, then. (starts to leave) See you later in class. (stops, and turns to Marinette, causing her to gasp) I'm glad to have you as one of my fans. (walks to the door and opens it, then looks back and waves, smiling, before leaving)

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette looking at a sketch and the Miracle Box
conversation:
Tikki: Hey! Marinette made that for me! (chases after Mullo)
Marinette: (sees Trixx looking at her diary, gasps) That's my secret diary! (tucks diary away in drawer)
Daizzi: (bouncing on an on/off switch of desk lamp) Day! Night! Night! Day! (continues in background)

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette looking at a sketch and the Miracle Box
conversation:
Alya: Marinette?
Marinette: (still holding Kaalki while the other kwamis watch the monitor) Oh, Alya! What do you think of my new squishies? Pretty cute, right?
Alya: What new squishies?
Marinette: Uh- (looks at Kaalki, confused)

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette looking at a sketch and the Miracle Box
conversation:
Ziggy: Ooh, so that's why I'm not showing up on these magic paintings!
Marinette: Right, she can only see me and I look completely ridiculous, don't I?
Alya: Marinette, are you feeling okay?
Marinette: (attempting to recover) Aaah! Hey, girls! So happy to see you! Now is just the perfect time for a chat!

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette looking at a sketch and the Miracle Box
conversation:
Alya: Marinette, you're acting weirder than usual
Marinette: Eh heh! I'm just... working out! (posing) I came up with this work out- it's uh- super special work out, hehe, to uh, be in shape before making squishies!
Mylène: You should get some fresh air, you look overwhelmed

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette looking at a sketch and the Miracle Box
conversation:
The girls: (gasp) Is Adrien there?!
Marinette: What? Of course not. (Her phone rings, Ziggy throws it, she catches it and sees who's calling) Luka? (drops the phone onto the keyboard, ending the video call)
The girls: (adoringly) Luka

scene: Marinette's room.
conversation:
The girls: (reacting to what Juleka said) Aw! That's so cute!
Marinette: (answering the phone) Wow, Luka! Hi
Luka: Hi and thanks for the pictures
Marinette: What do you mean "thanks"?
Luka: Thanks for the photos of your bedroom (Marinette checks phone and discovers the accidentally-sent pictures by Ziggy) and of Adrien
Marinette: Ah, my room! Yeah, I- uh- it's full of photos of Adrien because I uh... I'm using them for fashion pics for my blog and I need your opinion on them because I know you have great taste, Adrien
Luka: My name is Luka
Marinette: Haha yes of course, Adrie- I mean, Luka. You're Luka, obviously, hehe, because you're you, and I am me, Marinette. Hehe, uh, I'm so sorry, it's just that I've been so busted- uh I mean, busy!
Luka: No problem, Marinette, it's cool. So you ready?
Marinette: (blankly) Ready for what?
Luka: Well... our date. (shot widens to reveal that he is in her house, waiting)

scene: Marinette and Luka get ice cream from André.
conversation:
Marinette: (trying to act normal) Phew, there was a huge line at the water fountain, so I went out to buy bottles at the corner market but then there was an akuma alert. We were stuck in the store and they wouldn't let us out. Good thing Ladybug saved everyone! (sighs, content but then the screen goes dark as lights come back on) Oh no, is it over already? (Luka gives her an understanding smile)
Marinette: (seeing Lollipop Boy) Uh, the ice cream is gonna melt, we need napkins. I'll be quick! (hands him the ice cream and runs off. Luka stares down at it disappointedly)
Alya: Bye!

scene: Under a bridge. Luka stops Marinette as they go on a walk.
conversation:
Rose: ♫ I love unicorns! I love unicorns! And cute little fluffy cats! ♫ (Luka playing his guitar solemnly. Marinette then arrives, takes a seat, and waves. He notices but doesn't acknowledge)
Marinette: I'm sorry about earlier. There were mosquitoes on the boat, I thought we needed some insect repellent but the drug store was closed so I had to-
Luka: Shh, listen, the song of the water. If you listen carefully at this very spot under the bridge, you'll hear a melody. (They listen to the river and smile at each other.) You know, I never knew my father and my mom would never bring herself to tell me. So when I just couldn't deal with it all, I would take refuge here and the melody of the water would console me. What about you, Marinette? Where do you go when you disappear?
Marinette: Uh-
Luka: You tell me, I'll accept it. If you're still in love with Adrien, I'll understand. I won't be jealous you know
Marinette: That's not it, not at all
Luka: Whatever it is, I just want it to be the honest truth
Marinette: The truth, Luka... is the only thing I can't tell you

scene: Under the bridge. Luka, still upset, looks down and closes his eyes, very rejected as the akuma and amok fly into his guitar pick necklace.
conversation:
Luka: (struggling against it) Truth needs to be shared, not taken by force, Shadow Moth!
Marinette: (shocked what he just said) Uh! Shadow Moth? No! Luka, please resist. I am so sorry!
Shadow Moth: Why should you resist when she doesn't trust you?

scene: The streets. Marinette hides to transform.
conversation:
Shadow Moth: (creates a Sentimonster) In addition to your power, you will be aided by Lighteye. (Lighteye is giant angry eye ball sentimonster) This sentimonster will be under your control. (Lighteye is created by the amok) It's time to expose the truth
Marinette: (unhappily) Tikki, spots on! Ah!
Alya: Bye guys, see ya. (Lighteye immobilizes her) Oh... (Truth shoots his beam at Alya)

scene: Under the bridge. Marinette breaks up with Luka.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Truth is, I only ever have this much fun with you. Catch you later! ((vaults away)) Wee!
Marinette: I don't want to lie to you Luka. I don't think I can- I mean... maybe we should... (Luka hugs Marinette)
Luka: When you're ready, I'll be here, Marinette. (Marinette leans her head on Luka's shoulder and closes her eyes.)

scene: Agreste mansion. Front Hall. The doorbell rings, Nathalie, hunched over, in her pajamas and with her hair in disarray, slowly walks toward the door.
conversation:
Nathalie: (Tiredly) And the alarm clock hasn't gone off yet
Marinette: (Still hugging Adrien) I've missed you so much!
Adrien: I've missed you too

scene: Agreste mansion. Front Hall. The doorbell rings, Nathalie, hunched over, in her pajamas and with her hair in disarray, slowly walks toward the door.
conversation:
Adrien: Actually, we saw each other half an hour ago too on our good morning video call
Marinette: Technically, it was 28 minutes and 12 seconds ago, one of the longest waits of my life!
Adrien: (Grabs the letter) A letter? For me? (Opens the letter and finds two green tickets inside) Two movie tickets for a 50th anniversary screening of "Vampire Horrific Musical Show"? It was mailed from Roubaix!
Marinette: Your grandparents?

scene: Agreste mansion. Front Hall. The doorbell rings, Nathalie, hunched over, in her pajamas and with her hair in disarray, slowly walks toward the door.
conversation:
Johnny: We're going to Paris for the occasion, and we thought you two lovebirds could join us. Like family bonding, you know?
Marinette: (Afraid) Wait, it's a horror movie?
Johnny: Oui! But with songs! Amazing, no?

scene: Agreste mansion. Front Hall. The doorbell rings, Nathalie, hunched over, in her pajamas and with her hair in disarray, slowly walks toward the door.
conversation:
Adrien: Well, thank you, grandma, grandpa, but Marinette doesn't really enjoy horror movies
Marinette: WHAT!? (Stands up from the couch) Nuh-uh! Old Marinette didn't like those movies, but new Marinette,(Nudges Adrien with her elbow) AKA Adrien's girlfriend is not afraid of anything, especially horror movies! (Laughs)
Johnny: Magnifique! We'll pick you up at 6:00 p.m. (Closes the video call)

scene: School Bathroom. Alya, Tikki and Trixx are inside with Marinette.
conversation:
Alya: Listen, girl (Kneels down to meet her eyes), you definitely do not have to go see this horror flick if you're not feeling up to it
Marinette: But...(Does a forward roll to get up and starts walking in circles)what if Adrien likes the film! He'll think that we don't have the same taste, that we don't like the same things, (Stops walking in circles) and he won't love me anymore!
Alya: Marinette, couples don't have to do everything together or like the same exact things
Marinette: Do you and Nino like the same things?
Alya: (Unbothered by her intensity) Yep
Marinette: And do you always do everything together?
Alya: Yep
Marinette: See?!
Alya: Nino and I are Nino and I. Adrien and you are Adrien and you. (Puts her arm around her shoulders) If horror movies aren't your thing, just tell him
Marinette: (Sigh) You're right

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Cafeteria
conversation:
Marinette: (Sigh) You're right
Marinette: (Smiling) Adrien and I are going to the Vampire Musical Horrific Show tonight, and it's going to be amazing!
Rose: Oh, you're so lucky! I wanted to take Juleka to see it for the first time, but the tickets sold out a minute after they went on sale

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Cafeteria
conversation:
Ray: That she seems to be more than just a sweet kind friend
Marinette: Leave Prem alone!
Adrien: Stop it!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Marinette and Alya are walking up the entrance steps.
conversation:
Marinette: (daydreaming) What?! Don't say that! This is super bad, what if Adrien totally falls for her?! I've never flown in a private jet; nobody's ever written a song about me; and I don't know a single person in Hollywood! Adrien will forget I even exist! (Lila guides Adrien along by the hand)
Marinette: (gasping) Where are they going? Alya, we've got to stop them!
Alya: You need to chill out, Marinette. My Ladyblog has the highest number of hits ever after that Lila interview! (walks away)
Marinette: What's going on? I mean has this Lila girl hypnotized everyone or something?

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont library. Marinette sees Adrien sitting at a table alone. Marinette hides behind a nearby bookshelf.
conversation:
Marinette: Huh! Me, jealous? No way! (runs after Lila and Adrien)
Marinette: Where is she?
Tikki: Marinette, Adrien's book! I need to get a closer look at it
Marinette: Why are you so concerned about his book? Hide, Tikki!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont library. Marinette sees Adrien sitting at a table alone. Marinette hides behind a nearby bookshelf.
conversation:
Lila: (puts her hand on top of Adrien's) I love superheroes!
Marinette: (gasps from behind the bookcase) It's already too late! (bumps into a book cart, pushing it by accident. Tikki watches Lila as she flips through the book turning to the page on Ladybug)
Lila: Ladybug!

scene: The Place des Vosges. Marinette hides behind a tree. Lila is sitting on a bench.
conversation:
Lila: Oh hi!
Marinette: (sees Adrien) Oh no! He's already here!
Adrien: Hey! (Lila throws the book in the trash behind her)
Marinette: She dumped the book in the trash bin! What a brat!

scene: The Place des Vosges. Marinette hides behind a tree. Lila is sitting on a bench.
conversation:
Adrien: Volpina?
Marinette: Volpina?
Adrien: Wait a minute! I think I read about her in my book

scene: The Place des Vosges. Marinette hides behind a tree. Lila is sitting on a bench.
conversation:
Marinette: You've got your book. I can't lose Adrien. Time to transform!
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! Yeah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)
Adrien: (holding Lila's necklace) Are you telling me this is a Miraculous?! (Ladybug lands in front of them)

scene: Marinette's roof. She sits perusing the superhero book.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Thank you!
Marinette: (to Tikki) This book could've been my connection to Adrien without my Ladybug mask for once, but I get that I'm not gonna be returning it to him
Tikki: I'm really sorry Marinette, but its information is invaluable
Marinette: Information? But it's all written in code
Tikki: I know someone who's been looking for this for a long time. He knows how to decipher the codes
Marinette: So what exactly is so special about this book?
Tikki: It contains all the secrets of the Miraculous powers. It's sacred and extremely dangerous in the wrong hands. He needs it back
Marinette: I don't get it, Tikki. Just tell me what's going on. Please, who is he?
Tikki: The Great Guardian. And I think the time has come for you to finally meet him

scene: Outside the bakery. August waves towards Marinette's room.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Marinette? (He lands. She hides the pacifier and drops it behind her back)
Marinette: Uh…
Cat Noir: This isn't the first time I've bumped into right after Ladybug transformed back. (gasps) Could you be…
Marinette: (She panics) Ah, in love with you! (She hugs Cat Noir)
Cat Noir: (whispers) Marinette?

scene: Outside the bakery. August waves towards Marinette's room.
conversation:
Cat Noir: How could I say no to that? Well, see you tomorrow then! (He leaves. Marinette's parents wave.)
Marinette: (She puts her face in her hands.) Ugh!
Cat Noir: (to August) I just thought that she followed us everywhere because she's a fan of Ladybug like her friend Alya. (August looks up and laughs) But it turns out that she's in love with me. Do you realize it's the first time that a girl's told me she's in love with me! (August burps) Tell me about it. If only Ladybug would confess her love to me like that. (He smiles and runs off)
Marinette: (muffled) This is a total disaster! (She flips over)

scene: Sunday afternoon. The apartment. Tom is setting out plates for brunch.
conversation:
Plagg: Are you kidding? At least please wait until after the cheese platter is served! (Adrien sighs)
Marinette: He's not coming
Tikki: But if he does, what are you gonna say to him?
Marinette: I'm sure he's not coming. He's in love with Ladybug. He's not gonna come have brunch just for macaroons
Tikki: He's been rejected so many times by Ladybug. Maybe he's changed his mind
Marinette: Cat Noir, change his mind? Ha! I seriously doubt it. No one's as stubborn and one-track-minded as him

scene: Marinette's balcony. Marinette and Tikki are still waiting for Cat Noir.
conversation:
Plagg: You're right. Breaking her heart with flowers will be (much) more romantic. (Adrien looks at the rose worriedly)
Marinette: I told you he won't come. (She leaves. Tikki looks out and sees Cat Noir making his way towards the balcony.)
Tikki: Eh? Looks like you underestimated Cat Noir's love of macaroons!
Marinette: (She turns around) I don't believe it! What a glutton!

scene: Marinette's balcony. Marinette and Tikki are still waiting for Cat Noir.
conversation:
Marinette: (She turns around) I don't believe it! What a glutton!
Marinette: Oh no! What if this doofus has (actually) fallen in love with me? For what? Seconds? Is that all his love for Ladybug is worth? Just one tiny declaration of love and that's it, (poof), he changes his mind?!
Tikki: Uh, since you and Ladybug are the same person, he didn't exactly change his mind
Marinette: (She puts her face in her hands) Oh no, I definitely have to tell him that I'm not really in love with him. Wait, I (can't)! If I tell him that I don't love him, he won't understand why I told him that I loved him in the (first) place! I only told him that I loved him so that he wouldn't figure out I'm Ladybug. But if he sees that I lied, then he'll (also) see that I did all of that so he wouldn't guess that I'm Ladybug! (yelling) And he'll figure out that I'm Ladybug! (The doorbell rings)

scene: The apartment. Sabine and Tom are setting the table. Marinette comes down the stairs.
conversation:
Tom: (laughing) Oops, sorry. (He puts Cat Noir back down and turns him to face Marinette. Cat Noir holds out the rose. Tom runs to Sabine's side.)
Marinette: Um, how are you? (They put out their hands in preparation to shake)
Cat Noir: Uh, fine. And you? (They look towards her parents.)

scene: The apartment. Sabine and Tom are setting the table. Marinette comes down the stairs.
conversation:
Tom: Voilà! (He sets down a heart-shaped two-tiered tray filled with heart-shaped vol-au-vents) Sweethearts' vol-au-vent. For two, of course
Marinette: Uh…
Tom: Tell me, Cat Noir, (Sabine walks to the table with a cup) is being a superhero a steady profession? (Cat Noir gets wide eyed and coughs out the food.)

scene: The apartment. Sabine and Tom are setting the table. Marinette comes down the stairs.
conversation:
Tom: What?
Marinette: You're right, Dad, it's gotta be super dangerous being a superhero's girlfriend. Maybe I should rethink this
Tom: (voice) Of course, not sweetie. (Cat Noir and Marinette show surprise) (to Marinette) Cat Noir won't be a superhero all his life. Once he's defeated Hawk Moth, (voice) (Marinette leans back) he won't need to run on the rooftops with a stick saving people. (Cat Noir grabs another vol-au-vent) d-I know! He could work in the bakery with me! (voice) (Marinette and Cat Noir look shocked) I could train you, young man

scene: The apartment. Sabine and Tom are setting the table. Marinette comes down the stairs.
conversation:
Tom: —Because my daughter (loves) them. What did you want to name your future hamster again, sweetie?
Marinette: (into her hands) This is a nightmare
Tom: Nightmare! Right. That’s a funny name, isn't it? (Cat Noir grabs more food. Tom takes the tray) I'm bringing soufflé

scene: The apartment. Sabine and Tom are setting the table. Marinette comes down the stairs.
conversation:
Sabine: Tom, how about we let Cat Noir tell us himself what he wants
Marinette: Good idea, because he seems like the kind of boy who changes his mind rather quickly. (She looks at him accusingly)
Cat Noir: (swallows) Well, actually, Mr. Dupain, Mrs. Dupain-Cheng, Marinette, here's the thing. You're really nice people and this meal is delicious and by far the friendliest I've had in a long time. (He puts his hand on Marinette's shoulder) Marinette, you're an awesome girl, and I get that you have feelings for me. After all, I'm awesome in so many ways, even (I) could fall in love with myself! (Marinette shakes her head in annoyance.)

scene: Marinette's room. She spins to her chair. Tikki flies out.
conversation:
Marinette: (excitedly) Oh, this is so— (She remembers she's supposed to be heartbroken.) Uh… (She looks at her parents.) So (sad!) (grabbing Cat Noir, dramatically) Oh, to think I spent all this time following you everywhere to tell you that I loved you Cat Noir! (cries) I am so miserable! (weeps on table) No one will ever love me! (Her father looks sad and concerned) (into her hands) I'll end up all alone with my hamster, (running to the stairs) and its name will be (inhales) (Loneliness)!! (She slams the door and continues crying)
Marinette: (singing) La, la, la, la, la! Ah, such a relief, Tikki. Phew! He's not in love with me. (Tikki looks disappointed)
Cat Noir: (getting up to leave) Well, uh, I don't want to bother you any longer. I'm really sorry. Thanks for having me anyway. (He exits)

scene: Marinette's room. The bubbles are rising from the floor.
conversation:
Hawk Moth: (in lair) That, and his and Ladybug's Miraculous, would be perfect
Marinette: What is this? Tikki!
Tikki: Marinette!

scene: Inside the thorny ball. Marinette is looking for Tikki.
conversation:
Cat Noir: Marinette! (He looks to the top and sees a ball of thorny vines.)
Marinette: (panting) (She grunts as she jumps down from a giant vine) Tikki? (She looks around) Tikki?
Tikki: Marinette! (She flies inside) Marinette!
Marinette: Tikki? (She runs towards Tikki's voice) I'm here!
Tikki: Marinette?
Marinette: (voice) Tikki?
Tikki: Where are you? (She looks around as the room turns)

scene: Inside the thorns. Marinette is still trying to find Tikki.
conversation:
Weredad: She will never be alone! (Cat Noir flips away and lands on one knee) Someday, a prince will come. A prince worthy of her, daring enough to face me! Who will brave the many dangers and pick the magic rose for her! He will be worthy of taking her from my guard!
Marinette: Tikki!
Tikki: This is a magic prison, Marinette. It looks like it's trying to keep me from finding you!
Marinette: Ah! (She looks around, lost) There must be a way out of here!

scene: Inside. Marinette is climbing to the rose. She grabs it.
conversation:
Tikki: Marinette!
Marinette: Tikki! Spots on! (She transforms in a flash of pink and dives towards Cat Noir and Tom.)
Ladybug: Ha! (She extends her arms and legs to slow down. She catches the akuma) Gotcha! Bye bye, little butterfly. (It flies away.)

scene: Marinette's room. She jumps through the trapdoor, bounces off her bed, and slides down her banister while detransforming. Tikki hides just as Tom, Sabine, and Cat Noir are entering.
conversation:
Tom: Marinette! (He hugs her tightly)
Marinette: (strained) Dad, I can't breathe! (He releases her)
Tom: Oh, sorry. I was so scared. You were so heartbroken because of that— (He clenches his fist, looks at Cat Noir, and growls angrily. Cat Noir straightens and giggles nervously.)
Marinette: Dad, stop! (She lowers his fist and puts her hand on his arm) Cat Noir has every right to be in love with Ladybug. (She walks over to Cat Noir) She's very lucky to have you. And just because you and I aren't in love with each other doesn't mean that we can't be friends

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Nathalie: I'm (not) part of the family
Marinette: What?! Does Lord Graham know you're practically Adrien's mom now?
Nathalie: I… could never replace Adrien's mother

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Marinette: But Adrien (isn't) alone
Marinette: (Realizes her mistake, puts on a British accent) Um, Mister Adrien is (not) alone in having some appetizers, I suppose. (Hands out plates to the guests)
Adrien: If I may, Lord Graham, I live with Nathalie

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Marinette: (with a British accent) Mister Adrien, could you come with me to the kitchen to check? Thank you very much. (The two follow Johnny)
Marinette: Nathalie, there's no way! Adrien can't go and live there with (that) Lord!
Nathalie: Marinette, "that Lord" is his grandfather and I have no right–
Marinette: There must be something that can be done

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Marinette: There must be something that can be done
Marinette: (to Adrien) What do you think about this?
Adrien: I don't wanna leave Paris, Marinette. I don't wanna leave you or Nathalie, but… they're my family

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Johnny: Oh, I see, so now you're calling me a thief, huh?!
Marinette: (with a British accent) Hold on, let's not get carried away. (normally, whispering) It has to be here somewhere
Adrien: (Tries to grab Plagg, who's now stealing from his plate. He fails, but draws the attention of his family) I… I'll look for it too! The twin ring… not here, (Checks under his plate.) not here either… (Goes under the table)

scene: Agreste mansion, dining room.
conversation:
Milly: (Cracks open another ballotine) (whispers) Why do you scream all the time?
Marinette: (Glares while holding up a tray of drinks before intentionally tripping with them, pretending it's an accident) Whoopsie! (The drinks spill all over the contract) (with a British accent) Sorry, I'm such a klutz
Emil: (Pulls out another contract to replace the soaked one, to Marinette's shock) I understand clearly, how (much) do you want? (pulls out his checkbook)

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Milly: No! I'm tired of turpid, aristocratic, patriarchal dictators! (An Ultrakuma flies into the room) I have the ring! (Puts it on her finger.) (I) am the queen! (No one) tells me what to do! (The Ultrakuma infects the rings.)
Marinette: (Observes the akumatization through the keyhole.) (to Nathalie) The key! Do you have the key?
Nathalie: (to the bodyguard) The key

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Adrien: (Arrives) What's happening?
Marinette: Adrien, (don't) stay here!
Ringmaster: On the contrary, (stay), since this fight is for you! (Throws her bowtie at Adrien. It encloses him inside a giant, golden trophy)

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Marinette: They can be, but (we'll) fix this!
Marinette: Tikki, spots on! (The Kwami enters her earrings.) Yeah! (Transforms into Ladybug)
Ringmaster: (Appears, with an announcer's microphone in hand) Welcome to the main event! In this corner, Johnny "The Fry" Grassette, (One werewolf appears) the Wonder from the North! And in this corner, Emil "The Duke" Graham, (The other boxer appears) the Terror from Albion. (Jumps on top of a platform above the ring) May the best weregrandpa take Adrien away! (Launches her bowtie into a bell, starting the match) Fight!

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Adrien: (Enters and searches) Marinette? Marinette!
Marinette: (Leaves her hiding spot) Adrien!
Adrien: Marinette!

scene: Agreste mansion, entrance hall.
conversation:
Adrien: Marinette!
Marinette and Adrien: (Hug each other) I was so worried about you
Milly: (Slips the twin rings off her finger) This ring belongs to Adrien. (Places it on the table) (He) should decide his own future

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette continuously taps her pen on her table while her career booklet is still blank. Tikki and Pollen are beside her.
conversation:
Adrien: Why don't we start by visiting the food trade booths? (grabs his bag) Come on, Plagg, it's time to think about our future!
Marinette: True, Tikki. My life is complicated. But at least one thing is simple: I know what I wanna do later! No need to go to the Paris Career Expo for that!
Pollen: What's a career, dear Guardian?
Marinette: Oh- Well, it's... your job! Something really important that you do and gives meaning to your life!

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette continuously taps her pen on her table while her career booklet is still blank. Tikki and Pollen are beside her.
conversation:
Wayzz: Or when she designed the alarm for this room! What a masterpiece!
Marinette: Sure, I love crafting but-
Ziggy: You guys don't get it! What gives meaning to her life is to be in love with Adrien, or Luka, that's her job!

scene: Île aux Cygnes, at the Paris Career Expo. Alec is hosting a reality TV show.
conversation:
Alec: (to the cameraman) Cut! CUT! (he and the cameraman walk away)
Marinette: André, how did you know that making ice cream would be your job?
André: My dear Marinette, being an ice cream man isn't a job; I used to have a job. Every morning, I would wake up and do something I didn't like doing. The only enjoyable moment for my day was when I would come home and concoct ice cream flavors that suited my mood. Until one day, in the same way that ice cream enchanted my daily life, I wondered if my true calling would be to try and enchant other people's lives, too! That's when the truly successful career is: a blend of flavors of what you can do, what you love to do, and what you can bring to others! (gives Marinette an ice cream) Strawberry and cherry for the indecisive lady, pistachio and pecan for the clear sighted young man
Marinette: Who? What young man?

scene: Île aux Cygnes, outside the Paris Career Expo. Luka, along with Marinette, Alec and his cameraman walk with him.
conversation:
Adrien: I thought things would be simple this way, that I'd be content to do what my father told me to. Like you, Luka, who decided to be a musician like your father. Or like you, Marinette, you've always known you wanted to be a fashion designer. But actually
Adrien, Luka, and Marinette: It's way more complicated
Luka: I don't wanna be a rock-star like my dad. I make music but that's not my career, it's my nature. What I want though, is for other people to be able to (feel) that music. That's why I wanted to be a stringed instrument maker; to make instruments so people can create emotions with them

scene: Île aux Cygnes, outside the Paris Career Expo. Luka, along with Marinette, Alec and his cameraman walk with him.
conversation:
Luka: I don't wanna be a rock-star like my dad. I make music but that's not my career, it's my nature. What I want though, is for other people to be able to (feel) that music. That's why I wanted to be a stringed instrument maker; to make instruments so people can create emotions with them
Marinette: I feel like I always wanted to try new things. But the things I want to do, the things I forget to do, and the things that I just have to do, it's a lot, and I don't know
Adrien: My father arranges it all for me, but when I think about what I really actually wanna do, nothing! My mind is empty!

scene: Île aux Cygnes, outside the Paris Career Expo. Luka, along with Marinette, Alec and his cameraman walk with him.
conversation:
Adrien: My father arranges it all for me, but when I think about what I really actually wanna do, nothing! My mind is empty!
Adrien and Marinette: I'm completely lost!
Luka: There's no one way to become Marinette or to become Adrien to find out who you are. You just need to learn how to listen to your inner melody. (leans closer to Marinette) Your inner music, Marinette, at this moment, is a little bit like a brass band where... all the instruments are playing a different tune. I totally get it why you're lost. (The three of them laugh.) But if you listen a bit more closely, the music of your band is really beautiful. You just need some time to understand it. (leans closer to Adrien) Your music, Adrien, sounds like it's being muffled by someone else playing a sad piano tune, but your true melody is a happy one. Pretty rock and roll, actually. (stands up and grabs his violin) You two will eventually find what's already in front of you, but you can't hear it clearly. Just let the melody flow

scene: Exterior, Île aux Cygnes. Luka continues to play the violin while Marinette and Adrien watch him play.
conversation:
Luka: Dad?
Adrien and Marinette: Jagged Stone?
Toy Vendor: (as Santa Claus) Merry Christmas, everyone! (continues to drop gift boxes)

scene: Exterior, Île aux Cygnes. Ladybug returns to the portalet where Luka hid her.
conversation:
Ladybug: Spots off! (detransforms into Marinette and catches Tikki in her hands)
Marinette: Luka! Thank you for hiding me in here
Luka: Uh- It was nothing, Marinette! You know you can always count on me!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Gardening class. The class are taking care of the various plants on the roof.
conversation:
Alya: She was scared of Ladybug? For real?
Marinette: Yes, I'm telling you! That's strange, right? I didn't do anything to her
Aglaé: A...a- lady..ladybug!
Marinette: It's nothing, Aglaé. It's just a nice little ladybug
Aglaé: Ahh! It's coming to attack me!
Marinette: Smells good, what is it?
Aglaé: Essential oils! The smell is supposed to repel bugs. Did it go this way? No! That way?! AHH! There's another one!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Marinette and Alya are walking Aglaé to her class.
conversation:
Aglaé: I know, but I can't control myself. I'm terrified of getting akumatized again
Marinette: At least you're safe here. There won't be any bugs in the classroom
Alya: Meet for lunch?
Marinette: This is all my fault. If I had the Butterfly Miraculous people like Aglaé wouldn't be so traumatized
Alya: It's not your fault, Marinette. You're already doing your best to free the akumatized people and fix all the damage they cause
Marinette: Maybe but...magic ladybugs don't fix everything

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Dr. Psiquat's office, the waiting room. Aglaé and her friends are sitting and waiting.
conversation:
Dr. Psiquat: Oh my! Alya, Max, Juleka, Mylène, I'm not sure I'll have time to see all of you
Marinette: Aglaé is your only appointment, Dr. Psiquat. We just came with her
Dr. Psiquat: Aww, your friends came with you. Quite significant, and very kind of you all. If you're ready Aglaé, you can come with me

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Dr. Psiquat's office, the waiting room. Everyone is sitting and waiting for Aglaé to finish her session.
conversation:
Alya: Dr. Psiquat is awesome. It helped a lot to talk to her, you know?
Marinette: Huh? I didn't know you were seeing her too, what for?
Alya: Well, let's just say some kind of complicated family issues
Marinette: You never told me about that
Alya: I worked it out a long time ago. I don't even think about it anymore

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Dr. Psiquat's office, the waiting room. Everyone seems to notice somethings wrong.
conversation:
Aglaé: No! I've talked enough already and nothing's changed. I'm never coming back!
Marinette: Was that Aglaé?
Alya: She took the elevator!

scene: Paris street, outside Collège Françoise Dupont. The group run out the door and find Aglaé on a bike.
conversation:
Dr. Psiquat: Wreckless Driver!
Marinette: Aglaé! Aglaé, what happened?
Aglaé: This was never a good idea. I can't be healed. I'm going home and shutting myself away forever, there's nothing that can be done!

scene: Paris street, outside Collège Françoise Dupont. The group run out the door and find Aglaé on a bike.
conversation:
Marinette: I'm going to try to help Aglaé. I'll be super careful, I promise
Marinette: I think it's best to cut Dr. Psiquat's session short for today. Tikki, spots on! (transforms into Ladybug.)
Plagg: Don't tell me, you want to play Cat Noir and rescue your girlfriend

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Butterfly greenhouse. Aglaé, her group of friends, and Dr. Psiquat are there.
conversation:
Aglaé: Mhmm
Marinette: Do you want to go back out?
Aglaé: Yes

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont. Butterfly greenhouse. Aglaé, her group of friends, and Dr. Psiquat are there.
conversation:
Adrien: Thanks for coming with me, and for understanding my need to talk to Dr. Psiquat
Marinette: Of course
Dr. Psiquat: Adrien Agreste?

scene: Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie. Sabine Cheng is handing a bag of chouquettes to Placide I.T..
conversation:
Marinette: Wait!
Marinette: Hello! (awkward giggle) Sorry, um, these ones are special. They're for Adrien
Sabine: What surprise have you come up with this time, Marinette?
Marinette: I'll tell you but only after I'm sure it's worked

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:
Félix: Living with this knowledge is

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:

Kagami: Yes, magic

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:

Marinette: I don't know, for a while I kept all the Miraculous with me in my Yo-yo, but that didn't stop Shadow Moth from stealing them from me
Félix: (looks away guiltily) That wasn't (your) fault

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:
Sabine: Where's Marinette?
Marinette: (having transformed back from Ladybug) I'm right here! (Laughs awkwardly)
Adrien: Ah! Great! I hope you're ready because I have another surprise for you!
Marinette: Uh, now?
Adrien: TA-DA! A beef rib!
Marinette: That's not a beef rib, those are lamb chops
Adrien: I know, but the butcher was out of beef ribs
Marinette: Oookay?

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:
Adrien: (to Félix and Kagami) I still can't figure out why you're here
Marinette, Kagami and Félix: (panicked)THE RINGS!
Adrien: What rings?

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:
Adrien: And... that's romantic?
Marinette: No! Not at all! Puree is a terrible idea! So that's why Kagami and Félix came to see me! To come up with a better puree- I mean, a better idea than the one in the manga!
Adrien: Aaah, what's your idea then?
Marinette: I-I'll tell you, but first you've got to help us find the rings because no rings mean no hiding place and no hiding place means no idea
Adrien: (finds the rings under his shoe) Ahh! They were right there, look!

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:
Adrien: (finds the rings under his shoe) Ahh! They were right there, look!
Marinette, Kagami and Félix: (relieved) THE RINGS!
Adrien: Watch this, Marinette! I might not be the best when it comes to knitting or choosing meat, but I can do (this)! (Blows into his hand and makes the rings disappear, shocking Marinette, Kagami and Félix) Magic

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:
Adrien: Watch this, Marinette! I might not be the best when it comes to knitting or choosing meat, but I can do (this)! (Blows into his hand and makes the rings disappear, shocking Marinette, Kagami and Félix) Magic
Marinette: What have you done!?
Félix: Where are the rings!?

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:
Félix: Huh? (Félix suddenly calms down) You're right, everything's fine.(Félix lies down on Marinette's cushions and closes his eyes.) Why am I worried?
Marinette: It's your mother, Kagami
Kagami: Ugh! (Kagami angrily grabs the phone) Mother, that's enough! I don't want to talk to you right now!

scene: Marinette's room. Marinette is hanging up Adrien's attempt of a T-shirt.
conversation:

Marinette and Adrien: Huh?
Yaksi Gozen: Félix Fathom you're a bad influence! You'll never be anywhere near my daughter again! (shoots a beam to Félix which paralyzes him)

scene: Outside Tom & Sabine Boulangerie Patisserie
conversation:
Yaksi Gozen: Kagami, get back here! (Jumps into the water.)
Marinette: Kagami and Félix's lives are in danger! Tikki, spots on! (Transforms into Ladybug behind her changing wall.)
Ladybug: Lucky Charm! (Gets a van that begins to fall on top of Yaksi Gozen, but she slices through it)

scene: Inside the Dupain-Cheng kitchen. Adrien, Marinette, Tom and Sabine are eating cutlets in the table.
conversation:
Adrien: When Marinette does it, it's sweet... but when I do it, it's just plain... weird
Marinette: No! What's weird is when you try to do things my way. (I'm) usually the one that does weird things. You're Adrien, you do rational things
Tom: And it's not true that you don't do anything special for Marinette, Adrien. If it weren't for your cutlets, we wouldn't be sitting at this table together tonight. You're already a part of the family, kid!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont locker room. Marinette is seen running into the girls' side from the courtyard.
conversation:
Rose: I made her a scrapbook
Marinette: (to Alya) Hey!
Alya: Let me guess, you just finished your gift
Marinette: I hope Miss Bustier likes it

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont locker room, present day
conversation:
Adrien: How 'bout you, Marinette? I'm sure you've come up with something awesome, as usual
Marinette: Oh, me? Uh... It's nearly roughing at all. Uh! I mean... It's really nothing at all! (She giggles nervously, then opens her present. The other students gasp in awe. She reads the writing on her present as she points to it) "If we wish to change the world, we must all learn to love each other." That's one of the first things Miss Bustier taught us when we first met her at school. I always keep it in mind
Students: Aww!
Marinette: I also added this tube of lip balm — Miss Bustier's favorite color!

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont locker room, present day
conversation:
Adrien: I'm so lucky to get a teacher like her for my first year in school. How about you, Chloé? What's your present?
Marinette: Nothing. Just like every year since kindergarten
Sabrina: It's not her fault, okay? Chloé just doesn't like birthdays! She never remembers them, just like her mom

scene: Collège Françoise Dupont locker room, a few lessons later
conversation:
Chloé: Permanent marker. (Sabrina hands a permanent marker to Chloé. Chloé glances at it with one eye.) Cap off. (Sabrina removes the cap from the marker.) I (do) have a present for you, Marinette Dupain-Cheng. (proceeds to use the marker)
Marinette: (to Alya) At last, this is Miss Bustier's class! This will be her best birthday ever!
Alix: This is for you!

scene: Literature classroom. There is a pile of wrapped gifts on her desk.
conversation:
Alya: So uncool, Chloé
Marinette: Seriously lame
Miss Bustier: Calm down. We don't want to get upset on my birthday, now, do we? (taking the present from Marinette) Well, I think this present is wonderful. (takes the lip balm out of the bag) It'll be my new cosmetics bag! Then I'll be able to think of both of you every time I use it
Marinette: What? You're not gonna let her get (away) with this?!

scene: Outside, then inside of Collège Françoise Dupont, the second floor hallway
conversation:
Hawk Moth: That feeling of injustice! What could be worse than being punished for someone else's wrongdoings? (charges an akuma with dark energy) Fly away, my little akuma, and evilize her!
Marinette: But Miss Bustier, it's so not fair! It was Chloé, pulling another...Chloé! And...(I'm) the one who's getting in trouble?!
Miss Bustier: Of course you're not in trouble, don't worry! As the class representative, I want you to set a good example for your classmates. Don't give into feelings of anger. Try to forgive Chloé instead

scene: Outside, then inside of Collège Françoise Dupont, the second floor hallway
conversation:
Miss Bustier: No! No!
Marinette: (anxiously) Don't give up! Think only positive thoughts!
Hawk Moth: (from his lair) Hello, Miss. I am Hawk Moth

scene: Outside, then inside of Collège Françoise Dupont, the second floor hallway
conversation:
Hawk Moth: Who said anything about evil? There's already so much hate in the world. I want to help you unite everyone together with love, at last! Isn't that your greatest wish?
Marinette: Miss Bustier, please! Breathe deeply and focus!
Hawk Moth: Zombizou! I'm giving you the power to spread love and compassion. Thanks to you, the whole world will be one big embrace! In return, bring me Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous

scene: Locker room
conversation:
Marinette: I will (not) let Hawk Moth do this to the best teacher in the world!
Marinette: (distressed) Tikki, spots on! Ah! (Marinette transforms into Ladybug.)
Zombizou: I have got some great news for you, students! From now on, everyone's going to hug and kiss and feel the love! Even you, Chloé
